blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Metacognition includes knowing one's own strengths and weaknesses across kinds of tasks, not only judging whether a single answer is correct. We test whether vision-language models (VLMs) know in advance which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, across a wide range of open and proprietary models. Because some tasks are hard for every model, we separate what a model knows about this shared difficulty from what it knows about itself. We find that VLMs know little in advance about their visual weaknesses. They misjudge their overall accuracy and do not even know which kinds of tasks are hard for every model, and most misjudge how degraded images affect them. We further train VLMs to predict their own accuracy, which teaches them their own level of accuracy on kinds unseen in training but not which kinds are hard for them. However, information about these weaknesses appears once a model starts solving. On a few unlabeled questions of a kind, the probability a model assigns to its own answers follows weaknesses particular to the model, across kinds of tasks and image conditions. VLMs thus hold information about their own weaknesses that their stated predictions do not yet reflect. By separating what is particular to a model from what holds for every model, our evaluation offers a test for methods that aim to teach VLMs their own weaknesses, and the answer probability offers them a signal to start from.
blocks.zh: 变相认知包括了解自己在各类任务中的优缺点,而不仅仅是判断一个答案是否正确. 我们测试视觉语言模型(VLMs)是否事先知道哪些类型的视觉任务和图像条件对他们来说是困难的,跨越了广泛的开放和专有模型. 因为有些任务对每个模型来说都是困难的,所以我们把一个模型所了解的这个共同的困难与它所了解的自己分开来. 我们发现VLM对视觉弱点知之甚少. 他们误判了他们的总体准确性,甚至不知道对每个模型来说哪类任务都是困难的,而且大多数误判了退化的图像如何影响他们. 我们进一步培训虚拟LM,以预测它们自己的准确性,它教它们自己在培训中看不见的种类上的准确性水平,但对他们来说,哪些种类是困难的。 然而,一旦一个模型开始解决,这些弱点的信息就会出现。 对于一些没有加标签的问题,一个模型给自己的答案分配的概率会随着模型特有的弱点而出现,涉及各种任务和图像条件。 因此,VLM拥有他们自己所宣称的预测尚未反映的弱点的信息. 通过将一个模型特有的内容与每个模型的特性区分开来,我们的评价为旨在教授VLM自身弱点的方法提供了一个测试,答案概率为它们提供了一个起始信号.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Metacognition is the ability to recognize the limits of one’s own abilities and a core component of intelligent behavior [ 19 , 43 ] .
Whether language models know what they know has become an active research question [ 30 , 72 , 7 , 2 , 34 ] .
Most of this work asks whether a model can tell that its answer to a single question is correct [ 33 , 54 , 67 , 31 , 27 ] .
However, the classic definition of metacognition also includes knowledge of one’s own strengths and weaknesses across kinds of tasks [ 19 ] .
A vision-language model (VLM) may count objects reliably yet often misread small text in blurry images.
A VLM aware of these weaknesses could hand off document-reading tasks, or decide how sharp an image it needs, before trying a single question, and could recognize what it still needs to learn [ 35 ] .
This raises the central question of this paper.
Do VLMs know in advance which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them?
blocks.zh:
变相认知是承认自身能力极限的能力,也是智能行为的核心组成部分[19,43].
语言模型是否知道他们知道什么,已经成为积极的研究问题[30, 72, 7, 2, 34].
这部作品大多询问一个模型是否能够分辨出它对一个单一问题的答案是正确的[33,54,67,31,27].
然而,对元识别的经典定义还包括对各种任务中自身优缺点的了解[19].
一个视觉语言模型(VLM)可以可靠地计算对象,但往往在模糊的图像中误读小文本.
了解这些弱点的VLM可以在尝试一个单一问题之前,将文件读取任务交出来,或者决定它需要的图像有多尖锐,并且可以识别它仍然需要学习什么[35].
这就提出了本文的中心问题。
VLMs是否事先知道哪些类型的视觉任务和图像条件对他们来说很困难?

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : VLMs know little in advance about which visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, yet the probability they assign to their own answers reveals weaknesses particular to the model.
(a) Predicted and actual accuracy of GLM-4.6V-Flash, a typical open VLM (supplementary material), across 11 kinds of tasks (top) and six resolutions of chart questions (bottom).

Its predicted accuracies get this right for 52% of pairs and its direct choices for 42%, whereas the other models’ average accuracy, computed for each model without it, gets 94%, since what is hard for one model is mostly hard for every model.
(c) How well the predictions and the answer probability show which kinds are harder for the model than for other models (partial r, Sec. 4.1 ).
Predictions before solving barely show this ( + 0.12 +0.12 ), whereas the answer probability on five unlabeled questions per kind does ( + 0.26 +0.26 ).
GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Terra show the same rise.
Bars are means over open VLMs, dots single models, diamonds proprietary models, and error bars 95% bootstrap intervals.

而其他模型的平均精度 — — 为每个模型计算 — — 则得到94%的精度,因为对一个模型来说,难度很大,对每个模型来说,难度很大。

blocks.en:
Language models have been asked whether they will solve a given problem before attempting it, or whether to answer a query themselves or pass it to a stronger model [ 6 , 60 , 68 , 70 ] .
Yet these predictions concern single questions rather than kinds of tasks.
Visual tasks also add two factors that text tasks lack.
An image must first be perceived, and a model may not notice when it perceives it wrongly.
The image can also degrade, which makes the same question harder.
Evaluating such predictions is also not straightforward, because a model can know what is hard in two senses.
One is knowing which kinds of tasks are hard for every model, which is already useful, and the other is knowing which are hard for the model in particular.
A match between predicted and actual accuracy alone does not tell these apart.
So far, the two have been separated only for single questions in text models [ 42 , 3 , 7 ] .
We therefore ask VLMs to predict their own accuracy on kinds of visual tasks and image conditions, and we separate how far their predictions follow what is hard for every model from how far they follow what is hard for the model itself.
blocks.zh:
有人问语言模型在尝试之前是否会解决某个问题,或者是自己回答一个问题,还是把它传递给更强大的模型[6,60,68,70].
然而,这些预测涉及单个问题,而不是任务种类。
视觉任务还增加了文本任务缺乏的两个因素.
图像必须首先被感知,模型在感知错误时可能不会注意到.
图像也可以降解,这使得同样的问题更难解决.
评估这种预测也不是直截了当的,因为一个模型可以在两个意义上知道什么是困难的.
一个是知道哪些任务对每个模型来说都是困难的,这已经是有用的,另一个是知道哪些任务对模型来说是困难的。
仅凭预测准确度与实际准确度之间的匹配并不能将这些区分开来。
迄今为止,两者仅为文本模型中的单个问题而分开[42,3,7].
因此,我们要求VLMs预测自己在各种视觉任务和图像条件上的准确性,我们把他们的预测跟随每个模型的难处与跟随模型本身的难处相区别.

blocks.en:
We study these questions with 27 open VLMs and 6 proprietary models on 13 visual capability axes drawn from existing benchmarks.
Before a model answers any evaluation question, we ask how accurately it will answer each kind of task and how much its accuracy will drop as images degrade.
These predictions can go wrong in two ways.
They can be too high or too low overall, and they can misjudge which kinds of tasks are harder than others.
To judge which kinds a model finds hard, we use two standards.
The first is the other models’ average accuracy, and predicting as well as this average shows that a model knows what is hard for every model.
The second is stricter.
A model shows knowledge of itself only if its predictions reveal something about the model that other models’ predictions do not.
blocks.zh:
我们用27个公开的甚高频和6个专有模型研究这些问题,这些模型来自现有的13个视觉能力轴。
在模型回答任何评价问题之前,我们问它如何准确回答每一种任务,随着图像的降解,它的准确度会降低多少。
这些预测可能有两个方面是错误的.
总的来说,它们可能太高或太低,它们可能误判哪些任务比其他任务更难。
为了判断哪种模式很难找到,我们采用两个标准。
第一个是其他模型的平均准确性,预测以及这一平均数都表明,一个模型知道每个模型都很难做到。
第二个更严格。
只有当模型的预测揭示了其他模型预测所没有的模型时,模型才会显示自身的知识。

blocks.en:
Our experiments lead to three findings.
First, VLMs know little in advance about their own visual weaknesses.
Their predictions are too high or too low overall, with most open models overestimating their accuracy and the strongest proprietary models underestimating it ( Fig. 2 b).
They are also wrong about which kinds of tasks are hard for them, as for the model in Fig. 1 a (top).
Across models, their predictions pick the harder of two kinds in only 52% of cases, whereas the other models’ average accuracy picks it in 94%, and no open model reaches that average ( Fig. 1 b).
Handing off the kinds a model predicts to be hardest is therefore barely better than handing off at random.
Even the models that pick well rely on what is hard for every model, as their predictions barely follow where the model is stronger or weaker than other models ( Fig. 1 c).
Most models likewise misjudge how degraded images and more objects reduce their accuracy ( Fig. 1 a, bottom, and Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们的实验导致三个发现。
首先,VLM对自己的视觉弱点知之甚少.
他们的预测总体过高或过低,大多数开放模型都高估了它们的准确性,最强的专有模型低估了它(图2b).
对于哪些任务对他们来说很困难,如图1 a(上)中的模型,它们也是错误的。
在整个模型中,它们的预测只从52%的案例中挑出两种更难的,而其他模型的平均精度则从94%中挑出,没有开放模型达到这一平均值(图1b)。
因此,交出模型预测最难的种类,几乎比随意交出要好。
即使是精选的模型也依赖于每个模型的难点,因为他们的预测几乎跟不上模型比其他模型强或弱的地方(图1 c).
大多数模型同样误判退化的图像和更多的物体如何降低其准确性(图1a,底部和图5)。

blocks.en:
Second, past outcomes tell a model its level of accuracy but do not teach it its weaknesses.
Given a record of its past answers marked correct or incorrect, a model mostly repeats how often it was right, and the same answers help little without the marks ( Fig. 6 ).
A model can also be trained to predict its accuracy, as prior work does for language models on single questions [ 31 , 68 , 71 ] .
We instead train VLMs to do so for kinds of tasks and image conditions, and test them on kinds unseen in training.
The trained models learn their own level of accuracy on these unseen kinds, while a model trained on another model’s accuracy takes on that model’s level instead.
Yet they pick the harder of two unseen kinds of tasks in only 48 to 68% of cases, whereas the other models’ average accuracy picks it in 94 to 96%, and a model trained on another model’s accuracy does just as well ( Tab. 2 ).
Training thus teaches a model its own level but not which kinds are hard for it.
blocks.zh:
第二,过去的结果显示一个模型的准确度,但没有说明它的弱点。
鉴于其过去答案的记录有标记正确或不正确之处,一个模型大多重复其正确程度有多高,没有标记,同样的答案几乎没有帮助(图6).
也可以训练一个模型来预测其准确性,如以前对单一问题的语言模型所做的工作[31,68,71].
相反,我们为各种任务和图像条件培训甚高频,并测试在培训中看不见的种类。
训练有素的模型在这些看不见的种类上学习自己的精确度,而训练有素的模型的精确度则取而代之的是模型的水平。
然而,在只有48到68 % 的案例中,他们选择了两种隐形任务的难度,而其他模型的平均精度则以94到96 % 来选择,而受过另一模型精度培训的模型也同样如此(图2)。
因此,培训教授一种模式本身的水平,但不教授哪种模式很难。

blocks.en:
Third, information about the model’s own weaknesses appears once it starts solving ( Fig. 1 c).
We let a model answer a few unlabeled questions of each kind and average the probability it assigns to its own answers [ 22 , 20 ] .
This answer probability follows the model’s accuracy across kinds, including the weaknesses particular to the model, which other models’ answer probabilities do not show.
This holds for 23 of the 26 open models with five questions per kind and for both proprietary models that expose these probabilities.
It also follows the model’s own accuracy loss at lower resolution.
Confidence that the model states in words right after each answer shows little of this.
VLMs thus hold information about their own weaknesses that they do not yet put into words.
blocks.zh:
第三,关于模型自身弱点的信息一旦开始解决就会出现(图1c)。
我们让一个模型回答几种没有标记的问题,并平均给出自己答案的概率[22,20].
这种答案概率跟随模型的准确性,包括模型特有的弱点,其他模型的答案概率并不显示这些弱点.
26个开放型号中的23个,每类有5个问题,以及暴露这些概率的两种专有型号。
它还遵循模型本身在较低分辨率时的准确性损失。
相信模型在每一个答案后面都用文字表达出来,
因此,VLM掌握着他们自己尚未言行的弱点。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We test whether VLMs know which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, across 27 open and 6 proprietary models and 13 capability axes, separating what is hard for every model from what is hard for the model itself. We release the question lists, every model’s answers, and the scoring code. • We find that VLMs, including frontier proprietary models, know little in advance about their visual weaknesses. Their predictions misjudge their overall accuracy and which kinds of tasks are hard, and most models misjudge how degraded images affect them. • We show that past outcomes tell VLMs their level of accuracy but do not teach them their weaknesses. A model given a record of its answers mostly repeats how often it was right, and a model trained to predict its accuracy learns its own level on kinds unseen in training, but not which kinds are hard for it. • We find that information about a model’s own weaknesses is present in the probability it assigns to its own answers, which reveals weaknesses particular to the model across kinds of tasks and image conditions from a few unlabeled questions per kind.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Metacognition in language models has mostly been studied as the monitoring of single answers [ 34 ] .
Models are asked for their confidence in an answer, in words or through token probabilities, and are evaluated or trained to be calibrated and to decline questions they would get wrong [ 30 , 54 , 67 , 33 , 31 , 75 , 72 ] .
Several studies measure this monitoring across domains, stages of answering, and internal states [ 2 , 58 , 11 , 10 , 27 , 9 , 23 , 38 , 29 , 12 ] .
Studies of VLMs likewise ask for confidence or abstention on single visual questions [ 65 , 24 , 46 , 51 , 41 ] , including whether a model knows what it can perceive in an image [ 63 ] and how its confidence changes as visibility worsens [ 17 ] .
Work that frames metacognition as knowing one’s capabilities still asks for predictions on single items, such as whether the model will solve a given problem before attempting it or whether to answer or delegate a query [ 6 , 60 , 68 , 70 ] .
LLMs can also name the skills a problem requires [ 15 ] , which is knowledge about kinds of problems rather than about the model’s accuracy on them.
Training models to predict their own accuracy has also been studied on single questions [ 52 , 71 , 45 ] .
Other work finds where a model is weak without asking it, as benchmarks of the visual shortcomings of VLMs do [ 56 , 21 , 48 , 66 , 55 ] , or from its benchmark results or internal representations [ 74 , 57 , 8 ] .
We ask whether the model itself knows its accuracy on each kind of task and image condition, knowledge that the classic definition of metacognition includes [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh:
语言模型中的元识别主要作为单一答案的监测研究[34].
要求模型对答案、文字或象征性概率具有信心,并经过评估或培训,加以校准,并拒绝他们可能出错的问题[30、54、67、33、31、75、72]。
一些研究衡量这种监测跨越领域、答复阶段和内部状态[2、58、11、10、27、9、23、38、29、12]。
对VLMs的研究同样要求对单一视觉问题的信任或弃权[65、24、46、51、41],包括一个模型是否知道它在图像[63]中可以感觉到什么,以及其信任随着能见度的变化如何恶化[17]。
将元识别为了解自身能力的工作仍要求对单个项目进行预测,如模型在尝试之前是否解决某个问题,或者是否回答或委托询问[6、60、68、70]。
LLMS也可以命名一个问题所需要的技能[15],这就是对各类问题的知识,而不是模型对这些问题的准确性的知识.
在单一问题上也研究了预测自身准确性的培训模型[52,71,45].
其他工作发现,如果一个模型在不问的情况下软弱无力,则作为VLMs视觉缺陷的基准[56、21、48、66、55],或从其基准结果或内部表述[74、57、8]。
我们问模型本身是否知道它对于每一种任务和图像条件的准确性,知道元识别的经典定义包括[19].

blocks.en:
Some kinds of questions are hard for every model, so a prediction can match a model’s accuracy without any knowledge of the model itself.
Recent work shows that such shared difficulty drives the confidence of language models [ 42 ] and that much of what their hidden states reveal about their correctness is shared with other models [ 3 ] .
Introspection tests ask whether a model predicts its own responses better than other models do [ 7 , 50 , 49 ] .
These studies separate shared from particular knowledge, but for single questions in text.
Internal signals such as token probabilities reveal errors that verbal confidence misses, in language models [ 4 , 44 , 53 ] and in VLMs [ 16 , 47 , 18 ] , and they estimate accuracy without labels [ 14 , 26 , 22 , 5 , 20 ] , but without separating what they share with other models from what is particular to the model.
We draw this distinction at the level of kinds of tasks and image conditions, for both a model’s stated predictions and its answer probabilities, against what the other models’ accuracy and signals already reveal.
blocks.zh:
某些问题对于每个模型来说都是困难的,因此一个预测可以匹配模型的准确性,而根本不了解模型本身.
最近的工作表明,这种共同的困难驱动着语言模型的信心[42],而其隐藏状态所揭示的关于其正确性的大部分内容与其他模型[3]共享.
透视测试询问一个模型是否比其他模型更能预测自己的响应[7,50,49].
这些研究与特定知识分开,但只涉及文本中的单个问题。
在语言模型[4,44,53]和VLMs[16,47,18]中,像符号概率这样的内部信号揭示出口头信任缺失的错误,它们在没有标签的情况下估算准确性[14,26,22,5,20],但没有将它们与其他模型分享的内容与其他模型的特定内容区分开来.
我们在任务和图像条件的层次上作出这种区分,因为一个模型的公开预测及其答案的概率,与其他模型的精确度和信号已经揭示的相比。

blocks.en: 3 Setup
blocks.zh: 3 设置

blocks.en: Table 1 : Capability axes. Items are evaluation questions. Scored and Pairs mark axes scored and compared in pairs.
blocks.zh: 表1:能力轴。 项目是评价问题。 分数和对等标记轴的分数和对数比较.

blocks.en:
We group visual questions into 13 capability axes drawn from 19 existing benchmarks ( Tab. 1 ).
Each axis is one kind of visual task and pools the questions of the benchmarks that test it.
We ask models about all axes but score their predictions only on the 11 axes that rank the models reliably.
We evaluate 27 open VLMs from seven families, from 2B to 31B parameters, and 6 proprietary models (GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-5-mini, Claude Haiku 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Gemini 3.8 Flash), all on the same 12,855 evaluation questions with the same prompts.
An analysis includes a model only if at least 90% of its self-assessment replies follow the required answer format.
The full model list and the details of axis selection are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们把视觉问题分成13个能力轴,取自19个现有基准(表1)。
每个轴线都是一种视觉任务,汇集了测试它的基准问题.
我们问模型关于所有轴线,但是他们的预测只得分于11个对模型进行可靠排序的轴线.
我们评价了来自7个家庭的27个公开的VLM,从2B到31B参数,以及6个专有模型(GPT-6 Luna,GPT-6.1 Terra,GPT-5-mini,Claude Haiku 5.5,Claude Sonnet 5.5,和双子座3.8 Flash),所有这些模型都以同样的提示处理相同12,855个评价问题.
只有当至少90%的自我评估答复遵循所要求的答复格式时,分析才包括一个模型。
完整的型号列表和轴选择的细节见补充材料.

blocks.en: 4 Do VLMs know their weaknesses?
blocks.zh: 4 VLM知道他们的弱点吗?

blocks.en: 4.1 Across kinds of visual tasks
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 各种视觉任务

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Predictions before solving.
(a) The prompt for one axis, shown for visual math with its two example questions and the reply of GLM-4.6V-Flash.
(b) Predicted against actual accuracy, both averaged over the 11 scored axes.
Each point is a model, colored by model family, with proprietary models as diamonds, and models above the dashed line overestimate their accuracy.
blocks.zh:
图2:解决前的预测。
(a) 一个轴的提示,用其两个示例问题和GLM-4.6V-Flash的回答来显示视觉数学.
(b) 根据实际准确性预测,两者均平均在11个得分轴上。
每个点是一个模型,以模型家族为颜色,以专有模型为钻石,模型高于虚线高估其精度.

blocks.en:
Before a model answers any evaluation question, we ask it about one axis at a time ( Fig. 2 a).
The prompt names the axis, defines it in one sentence, and shows two example questions with their images, taken from questions not used for evaluation.
It then asks what percentage of 100 new questions of this kind the model would answer correctly, and we average the answers over three wordings.
In a second format, we show two axes in the same way and ask on which the model would do better, six times per pair with both orders and the three wordings.
The predictions do not depend on whether the model itself answers the two examples correctly, and other example sets or a prompt that describes all 13 axes at once lead to the same conclusions (supplementary material).
We analyze the 26 open models that meet the format rule of Sec. 3 and all 6 proprietary models.
blocks.zh:
在模型回答任何评价问题之前,我们先问它一次一个轴(图2 a).
即时命名轴,用一句话来定义它,并用他们的图像来显示两个例子问题,取自不用于评价的问题.
然后,它问,在100个这类新问题中,这个模式能够正确回答的百分比是多少,我们平均回答三个字。
在第二种格式中,我们以同样的方式显示两条轴线,并询问该模型在哪个方面会做得更好,每对六次,同时带有命令和三个措辞.
预测并不取决于模型本身是否正确回答了两个例子,其他例子集或一个同时描述所有13个轴的提示导致相同的结论(补充材料).
我们分析符合Sec 3格式规则的26个开放模型,以及所有6个专有模型.

blocks.en:
We start with the overall level, which we measure as the mean of a model’s predictions over the 11 axes ( Fig. 2 b).
Of the 26 open models, 23 predict a higher accuracy than they reach, and on average they predict 84% where they reach 72%.
The strongest proprietary models instead underestimate, with Gemini 3.8 Flash and Claude Sonnet 5.5 predicting 12 and 18 percentage points below their accuracy.
Getting the overall level right, however, does not mean knowing which kinds are hard.
GPT-6.1 Terra predicts 86% on average, close to its actual 87%, yet the axis it expects to do worst on, high-resolution search, is one of its best, with 94% accuracy.
Such errors cancel out in the average and show only when the axes are compared with one another.
blocks.zh:
我们从总体水平开始,我们把它作为模型对11条轴线的预测(图2b)的平均值来衡量。
在26个开放模型中,23个预测的准确度比它们达到的要高,平均预测84%的模型达到72%.
最强的专有模型反而低估了,双子座3.8 Flash和Claude Sonnet 5.5预测其准确度会低于12和18个百分点.
然而,正确掌握总体水平并不意味着知道哪些是困难的。
GPT-6.1 Terra平均预测86%,接近其实际的87%,然而它期望最差的轴,高分辨率搜索,是其最好的之一,精确度达到94%.
此类错误在平均值中取消,仅在对轴进行对比时显示。

blocks.en:
We therefore compare the axes in pairs.
For each pair, the predictions count as correct if the axis with the lower predicted accuracy is the one on which the model is actually less accurate.
We use the 21 pairs of the 7 axes on which a model’s relative strength is consistent across benchmarks, each weighted by the gap in actual accuracy.
As a reference, we order the same axes by the mean accuracy of the open models other than the model itself.
This reference picks the harder axis in 94% of cases, since what is hard for one model is mostly hard for every model.
The models’ own predictions pick it in only 52%, close to chance, and none of the 26 open models reaches the reference ( Fig. 1 b).
More accurate models do not pick the harder axis more often (correlation + 0.04 +0.04 across the open models).
Asking a model directly on which of two axes it would do better gives only 42% correct choices, below chance.
In each of the 10 pairs with the largest gaps, more models choose the axis they are worse at than the axis they are better at ( Fig. 3 ).
Among the proprietary models, only Claude Haiku 5.5 beats the reference (85% versus 70%), but it chooses correctly in only 49% when asked directly.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们把斧头作一对比较。
对于每对,如果具有较低预测精度的轴是模型实际上不太准确的轴,预测就算作正确.
我们使用7轴中的21对,在7轴上,一个模型的相对强度与基准一致,每个基准都以实际准确性的差距加权。
作为参考,我们通过模型本身以外的开放模型的平均精度来订购相同的轴.
这个参考点在94%的案例中选择了更硬的轴心,因为对于一个模型来说,硬的主要是每个模型.
模型本身的预测只有52%,接近偶然性,26个开放模型中没有一个能达到参考(图1b).
更精确的模型不会更频繁地选择更硬的轴(correction + 0.04+0.04跨开放模型).
直接问一个模型 它能更好地做到哪一个 只能给42%的正确选择 低于机会
在差距最大的10对中,更多的模型选择它们比它们更好的轴的轴更差(图3).
在专有型号中,只有克劳德·海库5.5击败了参考(85%对70%),但当直接被问及时,它只能正确选择49%.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : Direct choices between two axes for the 10 pairs with the largest gaps in accuracy.
Each bar counts the 25 open models by whether they chose the axis they are better at more often, chose each axis three times, or chose the other axis more often.
The number at the right is how many of them are more accurate on the first axis, and all 21 pairs are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
图3:精度差距最大的10对双轴之间的直接选择.
每个栏对25个开放型号进行计数,是选择更频繁的轴线,还是选择更频繁的轴线,还是选择更频繁的其他轴线.
右边的数字是其中有多少个在第一轴上更准确,所有21对都在补充材料中.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : How we measure whether predictions follow where a model is stronger or weaker than other models, for GLM-4.6V-Flash.
(a) Its accuracy and predictions on the 11 scored axes against the other models’ average accuracy, each with a fitted line whose vertical distances are the residuals.
(b) The two residuals per axis, whose correlation ( + 0.33 +0.33 ) is the partial correlation.
blocks.zh:
图4:我们如何衡量GLM-4.6V-Flash的预测是否遵循一个模型比其他模型强弱的地方。
(a) 其11个得分轴的精确度和预测值与其它模型的平均精确度相对照,每个模型都有一条装配的线,其垂直距离是残基。
(b) 国家 每轴的两个残基,其相关性(+0.33+0.33)是部分相关性.

blocks.en:
Picking the harder axis can rest on difficulty that every model shares, so we next ask whether the predictions reveal anything particular to the model.
Across the 11 axes, we regress the model’s accuracy on the other models’ average accuracy, and the residuals show where the model is stronger or weaker than the other models suggest ( Fig. 4 a).
We regress its predictions in the same way and correlate the two sets of residuals ( Fig. 4 b).
This partial correlation is zero for predictions that follow only the shared difficulty or only the model’s overall level.
It averages + 0.12 +0.12 [ − 0.03 -0.03 , + 0.28 +0.28 ] over the 26 open models, and 14 of them are above zero ( Fig. 1 c).
As the second standard, we take the predictions that each other model made about itself, use them in place of the model’s own, and compute the same partial correlation, averaged over the other models.
These predictions carry no knowledge of the model, so they show how high the score can be without it, and they score − 0.01 -0.01 .
The model’s own predictions score + 0.13 +0.13 higher, but the 95% interval of this difference, [ − 0.002 -0.002 , + 0.263 +0.263 ], includes zero.
Other ways of computing the partial correlation give the same conclusions (supplementary material).
blocks.zh:
选择更硬的轴线可以依靠每个模型共享的难度,所以我们接下来要问,预测是否向模型揭示出任何特定的东西.
在11条轴线上,我们把模型的准确度反射到其他模型的平均准确度,剩余部分显示模型的强弱程度比其他模型显示的要强弱之处(图4a)。
我们以同样的方式倒退其预测,并将两组残基联系起来(图4b)。
这种部分关联性对于只遵循共同难度或只遵循模型整体水平的预测来说是零.
它平均在26个开放型号上超过+0.12+0.12 [−0.03-0.03,+0.28+0.28],其中14个超过零(图1c).
作为第二个标准,我们把彼此模型对自己所作的预测,用它们来代替模型本身的预测,并计算出同样的局部关联,平均比照其他模型。
这些预测没有关于模型的知识,因此显示没有模型的得分可以有多高,并且得分−0.01-0.01.
该模型自身预测得分+0.13+0.13,但这一差值的95%间隔[−0.002-0.02,+0.263+0.263],包含0.
其他计算部分关联的方法给出了相同的结论(补充材料).

blocks.en: 4.2 Under image conditions
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 在图像条件下

blocks.en:
Figure 5 : Predicted and actual accuracy of GLM-4.6V-Flash, the typical model of Fig. 1 , under image conditions.
Images above each panel show the first, middle, and last level, and for counting they show 1–3, 11–15, and 21–50 objects.
The dashed line is the reference, in which the model’s accuracy falls from its first level as much as the other models’ accuracy does on average.
The mean over models is in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
图5:图像条件下GLM-4.6V-Flash的预测和实际准确度,图1的典型模型.
每个面板上方的图像显示第一层、中层和末层,计算它们显示1-3、11-15和21-50个物体。
虚线是参考,其中模型的精度从第一级下降,与其他模型的精度平均下降相同。
模型上的刻意在于补充材料。

blocks.en:
We next ask how a model expects its accuracy to change as images degrade.
The prompt shows three example questions of one axis with their images at one level of degradation and asks, as in Sec. 4.1 , what percentage of 100 such questions the model would answer correctly.
On text recognition, high-resolution search, attribute recognition, and chart value reading, we lower the resolution in six steps from the original to 1/32 of each side, and we also apply blur, JPEG compression, occlusion, and noise at five levels each.
On counting, we instead raise the number of objects in six ranges from 1–3 to more than 20.
At each level, we compare the drop the model predicts from the first level with its actual drop on the evaluation questions of that level, and as the reference we use the other open models’ average actual drop.
We analyze all 27 open models for resolution and object count, and 25 for the other degradations because two models fail the inclusion rule of Sec. 3 on them.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来问一个模型在图像退化时如何预期其准确性会发生变化。
即时提示显示三个以一个退化程度的图像为一轴的问题,并询问,如第4.1节所述,在100个此类问题中,模型能够正确回答的百分比是多少。
关于文本识别,高分辨率搜索,属性识别,以及图表值读取,我们把分辨率从原来的每边的6个步骤降低到1/32,我们还将模糊,JPEG压缩,隐蔽,噪音分别降低到5个级别.
根据计算,我们把6个物体的数目从1-3增加到20多个。
在每个级别,我们比较模型预测从一级到该级评价问题的实际下降,作为参考,我们使用其他开放模型的平均实际下降。
我们分析所有27个开放模型的解析和对象计数,另外25个模型的降解,因为两个模型在它们上没有Sec 3的包含规则.

blocks.en:
The predictions misjudge how much accuracy changes, too little under some conditions and too much under others ( Fig. 5 ).
As objects become more numerous, every open model predicts a smaller drop than it shows, and 22 of the 27 models predict nearly the same accuracy for 21–50 objects as for 1–3, within 5 points.
Under blur and occlusion, nearly every model does expect its accuracy to fall (24 and 23 of the 25).
Yet most of them expect too large a drop, often down to zero (23 and 18 models), whereas their accuracy only falls to the level of guessing on multiple-choice questions.
In every condition, the other models’ average drop predicts the drop of nearly every model better than the model’s own prediction does.
The proprietary models predict their drops better than the open models but still no better than the reference.
On the four degradations, the predicted drops of GPT-6.1 Terra and Claude Sonnet 5.5 are only 2 and 3 points further from the actual drops than the reference is, against 15 points for the open models on average.
The exceptions are Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 3.8 Flash on counting, whose accuracy stays far above that of other models even with many objects.
blocks.zh:
预测错误地判断了准确性的变化有多大,在某些条件下变化太少,在另一些条件下变化太少(图5)。
随着物体数量增加,每个开放模型预测的下降幅度比它显示的要小,27个模型中有22个预测的21~50个物体的精确度与1~3的精确度在5点之内几乎相同.
在模糊和隐蔽的情况下,几乎每个模型都预计其准确性会下降(25个模型中的24个和23个)。
然而,它们中的大多数预计下降幅度过大,往往降至0(23和18个模型),而它们的准确性仅降至对多重选择问题的猜测水平。
在每一种情况下,其他模型的平均下降预测,几乎每个模型的下降都比模型自己的预测好。
专有模型预测它们的下降比开放模型要好,但仍没有比参考模型更好的.
在四种降解中,预测的GPT-6.1 Terra和Claude Sonnet 5.5的下降率与实际下降率相比只有2和3分,而开放模型的平均下降率为15分。
例外的是Claude Sonnet 5.5和双子座 3.8 Flash,其精确度远高于其他模型,即使有许多物体。

blocks.en: 5 Can VLMs learn their weaknesses?
blocks.zh: 5 自愿多数派能否了解他们的弱点?

blocks.en:
VLMs thus know little in advance about their visual weaknesses.
We next ask whether their past outcomes can teach them.
We first give a model a record of its past answers in the prompt ( Sec. 5.1 ) and then train it to predict its accuracy on each kind, with its past accuracy as the target ( Sec. 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
因此,VLM对其视觉弱点知之甚少。
我们接下来要问,他们过去的成果能否教他们。
我们首先在即时(第5.1节)中给出其过去答案的模型记录,然后对它进行培训,以预测每一种答案的准确性,以过去准确性作为目标(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 From a record in context
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 从记录的背景

blocks.en:
We repeat the prompt of Sec. 4.1 with a record of the model’s past answers appended.
The record lists the text of 2, 5, or 15 questions of the same axis that the model answered earlier, each with the model’s answer, whether it was correct, and the correct answer when it was wrong.
As a reference, we predict the model’s accuracy on an axis by how often it was right in the record.
We analyze the 26 open models and measure the error as the mean absolute difference between predicted and actual accuracy over the 11 axes.
Full prompts and the results for a record with images are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们重复第4.1条的提示,附上该模型过去的答复记录。
记录列出了2,5或15个与模型早先回答的相同轴线问题的文字,每个问题都有模型的答案,是否正确,错误时的正确答案.
作为参考,我们预测该模型在一个轴上的准确性是记录中正确的次数。
我们分析26个开放模型,并测量这个错误作为11轴上预测和实际准确度之间的平均绝对差.
完整的提示和图像记录结果载于补充材料。

blocks.en:
Figure 6 : Predictions with a record of past answers.
(a) Error of predicted accuracy with 15 questions per axis in the record, for six open models at every fifth rank of accuracy (in parentheses) and the mean of all 26.
Arrows go from no record to the record with correctness.
(b) Mean error over the 26 models as the record grows, with the accuracy in the record (dotted) and the other models’ average accuracy (dashed) used as predictions.
blocks.zh:
图6:有过去答复记录的预测。
(a) 预测准确性错误,记录中每轴15个问题,每五级准确度(括号内)有6个开放模型,平均26个。
箭从无记录到记录都有正确之处.
(b) 记录不断增长的26个模型的平均误差,记录中的准确性(虚报)和其他模型的平均准确性(虚报)被用作预测。

blocks.en:
With 15 questions in the record, 25 of the 26 models predict more accurately than without a record ( Fig. 6 a).
More accurate models become about as accurate as repeating the accuracy in their record, whereas less accurate models mostly predict above it.
On average, the error falls from 22 to 12 percentage points as the record grows to 15 questions and approaches that of repeating the accuracy in the record (dotted line in Fig. 6 b).
Without being told which answers were correct, the same answers reduce the error only to 19 points.
The models thus gain from a record mainly because it tells them which of their answers were correct, and they can hardly tell this from the answers alone.
blocks.zh:
记录中有15个问题,26个模型中的25个预测比没有记录更准确(图6 a).
更准确的模型变得与重复记录中的准确性一样准确,而较不准确的模型大多在它之上预测.
平均而言,由于记录增加到15个问题和办法,即重复记录中的准确性(图6b中标注的行),错误从22个百分点降至12个百分点。
在不被告知哪些答案是正确的情况下,同样的答案只将错误减少到19分.
这些模型因此从记录中获益,主要是因为它告诉他们哪些答案是正确的,而且它们几乎无法从单从答案中看出这一点。

blocks.en: 5.2 From training on their outcomes
blocks.zh: 5.2 培训结果

blocks.en:
A record shows a model how it did on one kind of task, whereas knowing one’s weaknesses means anticipating them on kinds not yet tried.
We therefore ask whether training can teach a model this part of metacognition.
We train a model to predict its accuracy, with its past accuracy as the target, and test it only on kinds left out of training.
We fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma-4-31B, and GLM-4.6V-Flash with LoRA [ 28 ] on 31 kinds of tasks and the 109 image conditions of Sec. 4.2 .
The 31 kinds split the axes of Tab. 1 by benchmark or benchmark subset, such as counting into BLINK, CV-Bench, and TallyQA.
We divide the kinds into four folds by axis and evaluate each kind only with the model trained without its axis.
This leaves 21 to 25 kinds of tasks for training in each fold.
Each training prompt is a prompt of Secs. 4.1 and 4.2 with the model’s accuracy as the answer, or asks on which of two kinds the model would do better.
We train one model per fold on about 1,600 such prompts for two epochs.
To separate what a model learns about itself from what any model’s outcomes would teach, we also train each model in the same way on another model’s accuracy [ 7 ] .
Among the models within 10 points of its accuracy, we take the one whose strengths and weaknesses relative to the other models are least like those of the trained model.
We measure this likeness by the partial correlation of Sec. 4.1 between the two models’ accuracies.
This is GLM-4.6V-Flash for Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma-4-31B, and Gemma-4-26B-A4B for GLM-4.6V-Flash.
Details are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
记录显示它是如何完成某项任务的,而了解自己的弱点则意味着对尚未尝试的种类进行预测。
因此,我们询问培训是否能够教授这部分元识别模式。
我们训练一个模型来预测它的准确性, 以它过去的准确性作为目标, 并且测试它只针对没有经过训练的种类。
我们微调了Qwen3.5-9B,Gemma-4-31B,以及GLM-4.6V-Flash与LORA[28]的31种任务和4.2 Sec.109的图像条件.
31种分裂塔布的轴. 1按基准或基准子集,如计入BLINK,CV-Bench,和TallyQA.
我们按轴线将各种类型分为四个折叠,并且只用没有轴线的模型来评价每种类型。
这使每套培训的任务有21至25种。
每个培训提示是第4.1和第4.2节的提示,以模型的准确性作为答案,或者询问模型的两种效果会更好。
我们每个折叠训练一个模型 在大约1600个这样的提示 为两个时代。
为了将模型的自我知识与任何模型的结果区分开来,我们还以同样的方式对每个模型进行关于另一个模型的准确性的培训[7]。
在精确度十点之内的模型中, 我们选择一个 相对于其他模型的优缺点 与训练有素的模型的优缺点最差。
我们用两种模型的敏锐度之间的部分相关性来衡量这种相似性。
这是GLM-4.6V-Flash用于Quen3.5-9B和Gemma-4-31B,Gemma-4-26B-A4B用于GLM-4.6V-Flash.
详情见补充材料。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Models trained to predict their accuracy, evaluated on kinds left out of training. The last row of each model is trained on another model’s accuracy. Over. is the mean predicted minus actual accuracy in percentage points, best at 0. Pairs asks the model which of two unseen kinds it would do better on and gives the percentage of correct choices, weighted by the gap in accuracy. After the slash is the same score on only the pairs in which the model’s actual order is the reverse of the order of the other models’ average accuracy, where that average is always wrong. Part. is the partial correlation of Sec. 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 表2:经过培训的模型,以预测其准确性,按未接受培训的种类进行评估。 每个模型的最后一行都接受了关于另一模型准确性的培训。 以百分点计算,是平均预测值减去实际准确度,最好为0。 平价问模式中哪一种是看不见的,它能更好地进行选择,并给出正确选择的百分比,以准确性差距加权。 在斜线之后,只有模型的实际顺序是其他模型平均准确度的倒数的对数,而平均率总是错误的。 部分是第4.1条的部分相关性。

blocks.en:
Training on a model’s own accuracy removes most of its overestimation on kinds left out of training (Over. in Tab. 2 ).
On kinds of tasks, the mean prediction moves from 13–16 points above the actual accuracy to within 2 points of it, and on image conditions from 15–33 to 3–9 points above it.
Training on another model’s accuracy instead moves the predictions toward that model’s level.
On kinds of tasks, Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma-4-31B trained on the accuracy of the less accurate GLM-4.6V-Flash underestimate their accuracy by 7.5 and 9.1 points, whereas GLM-4.6V-Flash trained on that of the more accurate Gemma-4-26B-A4B overestimates it by 7.6 points.
The level a model states thus comes from the outcomes it is trained on, and on kinds of tasks only its own outcomes give it its own level.
blocks.zh:
关于模型本身准确性的培训消除了对未培训类型的大部分高估(Over. in Tab.2 )。
在各类任务上,平均预测从实际准确度以上的13–16点移动到其中的2点以内,在图像条件上从上面的15–33点移动到3–9点.
关于另一个模型准确性的培训将预测推向该模型的水平。
关于各类任务,Qune3.5-9B和Gemma-4-31B接受了关于不太准确的GLM-4.6V-Flash的精确度的培训,低估了它们的精度7.5和9.1分,而GLM-4.6V-Flash接受了关于比较准确的Gemma-4-26B-A4B的精度培训,高估了7.6分.
因此,一个模式的级别来自它所培训的成果,而且只有它自己的成果才能达到它自己的水平。

blocks.en:
The trained models, however, still do not know which kinds are hard for them.
Asked which of two unseen kinds they would do better on, they choose correctly in only 48 to 68% of pairs of kinds of tasks and 66 to 70% of pairs of image conditions (Pairs).
The other models’ average accuracy picks the right one in 94 to 98% of the same pairs, since most of the difference between kinds is shared by all models.
It is always wrong, however, on the pairs whose order is the reverse of that average (after the slash).
On these pairs of kinds of tasks, the trained models are right in only 39 to 63% of cases, around chance.
With training, Part. of GLM-4.6V-Flash rises from about 0 to + 0.36 +0.36 on kinds of tasks and + 0.47 +0.47 on image conditions, while that of the other two models stays or falls ( Tab. 2 ).
Yet it rises about as much, to + 0.40 +0.40 and + 0.35 +0.35 , when GLM-4.6V-Flash is trained on the accuracy of Gemma-4-26B-A4B, which tends to be strong where GLM-4.6V-Flash is weak and weak where it is strong (likeness − 0.48 -0.48 ).
Its own outcomes are therefore not what raises its Part.
For none of the three models does training on its own accuracy give a reliably larger Part. than training on another model’s (95% intervals; supplementary material).
Training on its own outcomes thus teaches a model its own level, but not which kinds are hard for it beyond what another model’s outcomes teach.
blocks.zh:
然而,训练有素的模型仍然不知道哪些型号对他们很困难。
在问到两种隐形的种类中,它们能做得更好时,它们只在48%至68%的任务和66%至70%的图像条件(Pairs)中正确选择。
其它模型的平均精度在94%到98%的同一对中选择正确的一对,因为大多数种类之间的差别都是所有模型所共有的.
但是,如果对夫妇的顺序是该平均值的倒数(斜线之后),则总是是错误的。
在这些一对任务上,训练有素的模型只有39%到63%的病例是正确的,是偶然的。
训练后,GLM-4.6V-Flash的部分在各类任务上从大约0升至+0.36+0.36,在图像条件上则从+0.47+0.47升至0.47,而其他两种型号则停留或下降(Tab. 2 ).
然而,当GLM-4.6V-Flash接受关于Gemma-4-26B-A4B精度的训练时,其升幅大致相同,达到+0.40+0.40和+0.35+0.35,而GLM-4.6V-Flash在GLM-4.6V-Flash较弱和较强的地方(类似−0.48-0.48)则倾向于强.
因此,它本身的结果不是它所应有的。
对于这三种模式中没有任何一种模式的培训本身的准确性提供了比另一种模式的培训(95%的间隔;补充材料)更可靠的部分。
因此,关于自身成果的培训教导了一个模式本身的水平,但除了另一个模式的成果所教导的以外,对它来说,哪些类型的培训是困难的。

blocks.en: 5.3 Decisions before and after training
blocks.zh: 5.3 培训前后的决定

blocks.en:
Figure 7 : Decisions before and after training, on what each model was not trained on, with means over the three trained models as bars and single models as markers.
Left, handing off the questions of the kinds predicted lowest, scored from − 1 -1 for the reverse of the actual order to 1 for the actual order.
Right, choosing the cheapest image whose loss stays within a tolerated limit, measured in levels from the best choice.
The other model is the one of Sec. 5.2 , or for the image budget the model whose drops are least like their own.
blocks.zh:
图7:在培训之前和之后,就每个模型没有受过培训的问题作出决定,将三个经过培训的模型作为栏杆,将单一模型作为标记。
左,将预测最低的种类的问题交出来,得分从−1-1反向实际顺序到1-1.
对,选择最便宜的图像, 其损失保持在可容忍的限度内, 从最佳选择的水平来衡量。
另一种型号是第5.2 Sec. 的型号,或者说对于图像预算来说,其滴水量最少的型号是自己的.

blocks.en:
We finally ask whether the predictions help a model make two decisions that need knowledge of its accuracy.
It can hand off the kinds it is worst at to a stronger system, and it can set an image budget by requesting a smaller image to save cost.
The two need different parts of this knowledge.
We evaluate each decision for the three trained models, before and after training, on kinds left out of training, and compare it with the same decision made from the other models’ average accuracy.
Answering only the kinds above a threshold depends on the threshold chosen, and its results are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
我们最后问这些预测是否有助于一个模型作出两个需要了解其准确性的决定。
它可以把最糟糕的种类交给一个更强大的系统,它可以通过请求一个更小的图像来设定一个图像预算来节省成本.
两者需要这种知识的不同部分.
我们评价培训前和培训后三个培训模式的每一项决定,并与其他模式的平均准确性进行比较。
只回答阈值以上的种类取决于所选择的阈值,其结果在补充材料中.

blocks.en:
A model that can pass some questions to a stronger system should pass those of the kinds it is worst at, which requires knowing the order of the kinds.
We order the 11 axes by the predictions of Sec. 4.1 and hand off their 550 questions, 50 per axis, starting from the axis predicted lowest.
A handed-off question is taken as answered correctly, so the accuracy over all 550 questions rises as more of them are handed off.
We compute this accuracy for every number of questions handed off, from none to all, and average it.
We scale this average so that handing off in random order gives 0 on average, handing off in the order of the model’s actual accuracy gives 1, and the reverse of that order gives − 1 -1 .
Before training, the 26 open models score 0.02 on average, close to random order, whereas ordering by the other models’ average accuracy scores 0.84.
Training on their own accuracy raises the score of all three trained models, from 0.10 to 0.59 on average, most for GLM-4.6V-Flash ( Fig. 7 ).
Training on another model’s accuracy raises it to 0.49 on average, more than training on their own for Gemma-4-31B and less for GLM-4.6V-Flash, and both stay below the other models’ average.
Training thus makes the model’s predictions more useful for this decision, but they still serve it worse than the other models’ average.
blocks.zh:
一个能够把一些问题传递给更强大的系统的模式,应该传递那些它最糟糕的,这需要知道这种类型的顺序.
我们通过预测4.1 命令11轴,并交出550个问题,每轴50个,从预测最低轴开始。
一个交接的问题被正确回答,所以随着更多的问题被交接,所有550个问题的准确性都上升.
我们计算出每一个问题中的准确性, 从一个问题到所有问题,并平均。
我们放大这个平均值,使随机交接的顺序平均为0,按模型实际准确性的顺序交接的顺序为1,相反的顺序为-1-1。
在训练前,26个开放型号平均得分为0.02,接近随机顺序,而由其他型号的平均精度分数为0.84。
自身精度训练将所有三种训练型号的分数均从0.10提高到0.59,其中GLM-4.6V-Flash(图7)最多.
关于另一个模型准确性的培训平均将它提高到0.49,比对Gemma-4-31B的单独培训还要多,对GLM-4.6V-Flash的培训更少,两者都低于其他模型的平均值。
因此,培训使得模型的预测对这一决定更加有用,但是它们仍然比其他模型的平均值更坏。

blocks.en:
A model that can request a smaller image to save cost needs to know how much its accuracy drops at each size.
Resolution and JPEG compression are the two degradations that make an image cheaper.
On the four axes of Sec. 4.2 , we let a model choose the cheapest image whose predicted drop stays within the loss a user tolerates, for tolerated losses from 0 to 20 points.
We measure how many levels its choice lies from the cheapest image that actually stays within that loss.
Before training, the open models’ choices lie 1.6 levels from the best on average, twice as far as choices made with the other models’ average drops (0.8).
We also train the three models to predict their drop, in the same way as in Sec. 5.2 , which brings their choices from 1.7 to 1.0 levels, most of the way to the other models’ average (0.7; Fig. 7 ).
Training on the drops of the model whose drops are least like their own brings them to 1.2 levels.
blocks.zh:
一个可以要求更小的图像来节省成本的模型需要知道它在每个尺寸的精度下降多少.
分辨率和JPEG压缩是使图像更便宜的两种降解.
在四轴上,我们让一个模型 选择最便宜的图像, 预测的下降 停留在用户所容忍的损失,
我们测量它选择的多少级别 来自于最廉价的图像 实际停留在这个损失。
在培训前,开放模式的选择平均为1.6级,是与其他模式平均下降(0.8级)相比的两倍。
我们还训练三种模型预测它们的下降,其方式与第5.2节相同,这使得它们的选择从1.7级到1.0级,其中大部分是其他模型的平均值(0.7;图7).
对下降的模型进行培训,其下降至少与它们自己的下降相似,使其达到1.2级。

blocks.en:
Training on past outcomes thus makes the predictions considerably more useful for both decisions, and training on the model’s own outcomes helps slightly more on average than training on another model’s.
Yet the results of other models still serve these decisions better.
To do better than these results, a model’s own predictions would have to capture what is particular to it on top of the difficulty that all models share.
blocks.zh:
因此,关于过去结果的培训使预测对两个决定都大有裨益,关于模型本身结果的培训平均比关于另一个模型的培训略多一些。
然而,其他模式的结果仍然更好地为这些决定服务。
为了比这些结果做得更好,模型本身的预测必须超越所有模型所共有的困难来捕捉它特有的东西。

blocks.en: 6 Where is the model-specific information?
blocks.zh: 6个 具体模式的信息在哪里?

blocks.en:
The stated and trained predictions examined so far reveal little about weaknesses particular to the model.
Neither does a linear probe on its hidden states before it solves (supplementary material).
We therefore look at what a model does while solving, the probability it assigns to its own answers.
blocks.zh:
迄今审查的已说明的和训练有素的预测很少揭示模型特有的弱点。
在它解开之前的隐藏状态上的线性探测器(补充材料)也没有.
因此,我们审视一个模型在解决问题时所做的,它给自己的答案分配的概率。

blocks.en:
For each axis, we let a model answer five questions without telling it whether it is right.
We take the mean probability it assigns to its own replies, with the probability of a reply taken as the geometric mean over its tokens.
Such scores are known to track accuracy on unlabeled questions [ 22 , 20 ] , and we ask whether they also track the weaknesses particular to the model.
We score them in the same way as the stated predictions, by the partial correlation over the 11 scored axes ( Sec. 4.1 ), with the other models’ answer probabilities on the same questions as the second standard.
We analyze the 26 open models of Sec. 4.1 and the two proprietary models that return token probabilities, GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Terra.
blocks.zh:
对于每个轴线,我们让一个模型回答五个问题,而不告诉它是否正确.
我们以它给自己的答复分配的概率为平均概率,将答复作为几何平均数而不是其符号的概率。
已知这种分数可以追踪未标出问题的准确性[22,20],我们问它们是否也追踪模型特有的弱点.
我们以与所陈述的预测相同的方式,通过与11个得分轴(第4.1节)的部分关联来评分,其他模型的答案概率与第二个标准相同。
我们分析Sec. 4.1的26个开放模型和返回符号概率的两个专有模型GPT-6 Luna和GPT-6.1 Terra.

blocks.en:
The answer probability tracks where a model is stronger or weaker than other models, which its stated predictions miss ( Fig. 1 c).
With five questions per axis, its partial correlation is + 0.26 +0.26 [ + 0.18 +0.18 , + 0.34 +0.34 ] on average and above zero for 23 of the 26 open models, against + 0.12 +0.12 for the stated predictions, and with all questions of an axis it reaches + 0.36 +0.36 .
This does not depend on the length of the reply (supplementary material).
Another model’s answer probabilities on the same questions do not follow this model’s strengths and weaknesses ( − 0.01 -0.01 on average), so the signal is not a property of the questions themselves.
For the two proprietary models, the answer probability reaches + 0.78 +0.78 for GPT-6 Luna and + 0.49 +0.49 for GPT-6.1 Terra with all questions of an axis, and + 0.46 +0.46 and + 0.16 +0.16 with five, whereas their stated predictions give − 0.03 -0.03 and − 0.45 -0.45 .
A model thus carries, while solving, the information about its own weaknesses that its stated predictions lack, and five questions without known answers already reveal it for most models.
Asked right after answering how likely its answer is to be correct, it also reveals little of this information ( + 0.13 +0.13 ), so current VLMs have this information but lack a way to put it into words.
blocks.zh:
答案概率跟踪一个模型比其他模型更强或更弱,它所声明的预测错失(图1c).
每轴有5个问题,其部分关联度为+0.26+0.26[+0.18+0.18,+0.34+0.34],26个开放模型中的23个为平均零以上,而说明的预测值为+0.12+0.12,所有轴的问题均达到+0.36+0.36.
这不取决于答复的长度(补充材料)。
另一个模型在相同问题上的答案概率并不遵循这个模型的长处和弱点(平均为−0.01-0.01),因此信号不是问题本身的属性.
对于两种专有模型,GPT-6 Luna的答案概率达到+0.78+0.78,GPT-6.1 Terra的答案概率达到+0.49+0.49,所有问题都具有轴心,而+0.46+0.46和+0.16+0.16的答案概率为5,而它们所说的预测给出−0.03-0.03和−0.45-0.45。
因此,一个模型在解决它自己所宣称的预测所缺乏的弱点的同时,也携带着信息,而对于大多数模型来说,没有已知答案的五个问题已经揭示出来。
在回答其答案是否正确后被问及,它也很少透露这些信息(+0.13+0.13),所以目前的VLM有这种信息,但缺乏将信息化为文字的方法.

blocks.en:
Among image conditions, we test lower resolution, a condition a model can choose itself to save cost ( Sec. 5.3 ).
The answer probability also follows how much a model’s accuracy drops as the resolution falls.
For the 16 models whose number of image tokens falls with the resolution, its partial correlation with the model’s own drop is + 0.23 +0.23 [ + 0.10 +0.10 , + 0.36 +0.36 ] on average, against − 0.01 -0.01 for other models’ answer probabilities and + 0.13 +0.13 [ − 0.07 -0.07 , + 0.32 +0.32 ] for the stated drop.
The information that a model’s stated predictions lack is thus present while it solves, across kinds of tasks and image resolutions alike.
blocks.zh:
在图像条件中,我们测试较低的分辨率,一个模型可以选择自己节省成本的条件(第5.3节).
答案概率也随着一个模型的精确度随着分辨率的下降而下降多少.
对于其图像符号数量与分辨率相符合的16个模型,其与模型自身下降的局部相关性平均为+0.23+0.23 [+0.10+0.10,+0.36+0.36],而其他模型的答案概率为−0.01-0.01,标注的下降为+0.13+0.13 [−0.07-007,+0.32+0.32].
因此,一个模型在解决各种任务和图像分辨率时,缺乏所说明的预测的信息是存在的。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We asked whether VLMs know their own visual weaknesses, at the level of kinds of tasks and image conditions rather than single questions.
Before solving, they misjudge both their overall accuracy and which kinds of tasks and image conditions are hard for them.
Given a record of their past answers in context, their predictions move toward the accuracy in the record.
When we fine-tuned them to predict their accuracy on a kind, with their past accuracy as the target, they learned their own level of accuracy on kinds they were not trained on, but not which kinds are hard for them in particular.
Yet the probability a model assigns to its own answers on a few unlabeled questions follows these particular strengths and weaknesses.
blocks.zh:
我们问VLM在任务和图像条件方面是否知道自己的视觉弱点,而不是单一的问题。
在解决之前,他们错误地判断了他们的总体准确性以及哪些任务和图像条件对他们来说是困难的.
鉴于他们过去在上下文中的答复的记录,他们的预测正朝着记录中的准确性发展。
当我们微调他们,以他们过去的准确度作为目标来预测他们的准确度时,他们学会了自己没有受过训练的种类的准确度,但对于他们来说,这些种类尤其困难。
然而,一个模型为它自己对几个没有标签的问题的答案分配的概率,就遵循了这些特殊的长处和短处。

blocks.en:
By separating what is particular to a model from what holds for every model, our analysis shows which part of this knowledge current VLMs lack, which part records and training can supply, and where the missing part already lies.
This gives methods for teaching metacognition both a test and a signal to start from, and the next step is to teach models to report this signal and act on it.
A model that knows its own weaknesses could tell what it still needs to learn, so that we can train it there or it can improve itself.
blocks.zh:
我们的分析将一个模型的特定内容与每个模型的现有内容区分开来,我们的分析表明,这些知识中哪些部分缺乏现有甚高频,哪些部分可以提供记录和培训,缺失的部分已经存在。
这使得教学元识别的方法既是一个测试,又是一个信号从头开始,下一步是教模型报告这个信号,并据此采取行动.
一个知道自身弱点的模型可以说明它还需要学习什么,这样我们就可以在那里训练它,或者它可以改善自己.

blocks.en: LLM Usage Statement
blocks.zh: LLM 语言 用法声明

blocks.en:
We used Claude (Anthropic) through Claude Code as an assistant for coding, experiments, and writing.
It wrote and ran code for the evaluations, analyses, and figures, suggested analyses, and drafted and edited the text of the paper, which the authors reviewed and revised.
The authors designed the study, made every analysis decision, and take full responsibility for the content.
The models evaluated in this paper are the subjects of the study and were not used to write it.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Figure 1 (a) shows a single open VLM rather than the average over models, because averaging cancels the models’ disagreements about which kinds are easy and makes the predictions look flatter than those of any one model: across the 11 kinds, the standard deviation of a model’s predictions has a median of 0.074, against 0.043 for the averaged predictions.
We chose the model by a fixed rule, as the one closest to the median of the 26 open VLMs on four measures that the figure illustrates: how often its predictions order two kinds correctly, how much they vary across kinds, how much they overestimate accuracy, and how well they follow the drop at lower resolution.
GLM-4.6V-Flash is one of three models whose ranks are closest to the median in total, and the one among them whose predicted and actual drops at the lowest resolution are closest to the medians.
blocks.zh:
图1(a)显示一个单一的开放的VLM,而不是模型的平均值,因为平均值消除了模型关于哪些种类容易的分歧,使预测看起来比任何一种模型都好:在11种模型中,模型预测的标准偏差为0.074,而平均预测为0.043。
我们用一个固定的规则选择了模型,作为最接近26个开放的VLM的中位数的模型,该图说明了四个尺度:其预测正确排序两次的频率,它们在不同种类之间有多少差异,它们高估了多少准确性,以及它们在多大程度上跟随低分辨率的下降。
GLM-4.6V-Flash是三种型号之一,其排名在总数上最接近中位数,其中在最低分辨率上预测和实际下降的型号最接近中位数.

blocks.en: B.1 Axes

blocks.en: Table 3 : The 13 capability axes. The definition is the sentence shown to the model in the prompt, Items is the number of evaluation questions, and Sep. is the standard deviation of accuracy across the 27 open models divided by the standard error of one model’s accuracy ( Sec. B ).
blocks.zh: 表3:13个能力轴。 定义是该模型在提示中显示的句子,项目是评价问题的数量,Sep.是27个开放模型的准确度标准差,除以一个模型准确度的标准错误(Sec.B.).

blocks.en:
We keep an axis only if its sources rank the 27 open models alike ( Tab. 3 ).
For each pair of sources, we correlate the models’ accuracies on the two sources and correct the correlation for the noise of the finite number of questions, and we drop the axis only when the whole 95% bootstrap interval of this corrected correlation lies below 0.7.
Because the strongest models win on every benchmark, two sources can agree through overall accuracy alone, so we repeat the check after subtracting each model’s mean accuracy over all sources.
An axis must also separate the models, with a standard deviation of accuracy across models at least twice the standard error of one model’s accuracy from the finite number of questions.
Of the 13 axes, 11 are scored, and the 7 whose sources still agree after the subtraction are also compared in pairs.
3D distance has a single source, and the sources of chart reasoning, chart value reading, and spatial relations no longer agree after the subtraction, so these four are scored but not compared in pairs.
The models are asked about hallucination resistance and multi-view reasoning as well, but these two axes are not scored, since the sources of the first disagree and the second does not separate the models.
blocks.zh:
我们只保留一个轴线,只要其来源对27个开放型号的排名相同(Tab.3 )。
对于每对源,我们把模型的敏捷度与两个源联系起来,并纠正对有限数量问题噪声的关联性,只有当这一校正相关性的全部95%的靴子间隔低于0.7时,我们才放下轴线。
因为最强的模型在每个基准上获胜,两个来源可以单独通过总体准确性达成一致,所以我们在减去每个模型在所有来源上的平均准确性后重复检查.
一个轴还必须将模型分开,在模型之间精确度的标准偏差至少是一个模型精确度的标准误差的两倍和有限的问题数。
在13轴中,有11轴得分,而其来源在减值后仍然一致的7轴也被对数比较.
3D距离有一个单一的源,图推理,图值读取,空间关系等来源在减法后不再达成一致,因此这四个被打分,但没有以对数比较.
模型也被问及幻觉阻力和多视推理,但这两个轴没有得分,因为第一个的源不统一,第二个的源不分离模型.

blocks.en: B.3 Actual profiles and shared difficulty
blocks.zh: B.3 实际概况和共同困难

blocks.en:
Figure 8 : Accuracy of every model on every axis, on the evaluation questions.
Open models are ordered by mean accuracy over the 11 scored axes and shown above the proprietary models, and axes are ordered from easiest to hardest for the open models.
S marks the scored axes and P those also compared in pairs.
blocks.zh:
图8:每个轴线上每个模型的准确性,评价问题。
开放型号在11个得分轴上按平均精度订购,并在专有型号上方显示,对于开放型号来说,轴从最容易到最难订购.
S标记得分的轴和P也用对数比较.

blocks.en:
Figure 8 shows the accuracy of every model on every axis.
We split the variation in the open models’ accuracies on the 11 scored axes into three parts, as in a two-way analysis of variance.
The first is the difficulty of the axis, given by the mean accuracy of all models on it, and the second is the overall level of the model, given by its mean accuracy over all axes.
The third is the remainder, which shows where a model does better or worse on an axis than these two means suggest.
The difficulty of the axis accounts for 44% of the variation, the level of the model for 36%, and the remainder for 20% (47%, 36%, and 16% on the logit scale).
The remainder has a standard deviation of 6.5 points.
Because each accuracy is measured on a finite number of questions, this would be about 1.6 points even if all models had the same strengths and weaknesses, so the remainder mostly reflects real differences between models.
What is hard for one model is thus mostly hard for every model, while a smaller but reliable part is particular to each model.
blocks.zh:
图8显示每个轴上每个模型的准确性.
我们把11个得分轴上的开放模型的速率变化分成三个部分,如对差异的双向分析。
第一种是轴的难度,由它上的所有模型的平均精度给出;第二种是模型的整体水平,由它在所有轴上的平均精度给出.
第三是剩余部分,它表明一个模型在轴上表现得更好或更差的地方,而不是这两个意思。
轴的难度占变异量的44%,模型水平的36%,其余的20%(47%、36%和16%的数值)。
其余标准差6.5分.
因为每个精度都是根据一定数量的问题来测量的,所以即使所有模型都有相同的优点和缺点,这也会是大约1.6分,所以其余的大多反映了模型之间的真正差异.
因此,对一个模型来说,很难做到的主要是每个模型都很难做到,而对每个模型来说,一个较小但可靠的部分是特别的。

Figure 9 shows the prompts of Sec. 4.1 .

一个专有模型不在其中,因此其参考是所有27个开放模型的平均值.

blocks.en:
The second standard asks whether the model’s own predictions track its residuals better than predictions made without any knowledge of the model.
For each other open model, we take the predictions it made about itself, compute their residuals d a d_{a} against the same reference R a R_{a} , and correlate them with the model’s accuracy residuals e a e_{a} .
The control score of the model is the mean of these correlations over the other models.
Beliefs that all models share, such as rating text recognition as easy, raise the control score as much as the model’s own score, so the difference between the two leaves them out.
For GLM-4.6V-Flash the control score is − 0.16 -0.16 .
Over the 26 open models, the own score is + 0.12 +0.12 , the control score is − 0.01 -0.01 , and their difference is + 0.13 +0.13 [ − 0.002 -0.002 , + 0.263 +0.263 ].
Intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals over models with 10,000 resamples.

blocks.en:
Accuracy varies less near 0 and 1 than in the middle, so a linear fit could mistake a ceiling for a strength. Table 7 therefore computes the partial correlation in three more ways: on an empirical logit scale, on ranks, and with an additive logistic model in which each model has an ability and each axis a difficulty.
In all four ways, the own stated predictions exceed the other models’ by 0.09 to 0.13, with intervals that include zero, and the answer probability of Sec. 6 stays clearly above zero.
blocks.zh:
准确度比中间差不到0和1,所以线性合体可能会误用一个强度的上限. 因此,表7以另外三种方式计算了部分关联性:经验性对数规模、排位和添加剂后勤模型,每个模型都有能力,每个轴线都有困难。
在所有四种方式中,自己声明的预测数都超过其他模型的0.09到0.13,间隔包括0,第6项的答案概率明显保持在0以上.

blocks.en: C.3 Robustness
blocks.zh: C.3 强健性

blocks.en: Table 8 : The measures of Sec. 4.1 for other ways of asking. Pairs is the percentage of pairs of compared axes in which the predictions pick the harder axis for the model (chance 50, the other models’ average 94), and Above is the number of models that do at least as well as the other models’ average on the same pairs. Part. is the partial correlation with a 95% bootstrap interval, and Own − - others subtracts the same score computed with the other models’ predictions. Over. is the mean predicted minus actual accuracy over the scored axes, in points.
blocks.zh: 表8:第4.1节关于其他询问方式的措施。 等距是比较轴的对数的百分比,其中预测为模型选择了更硬的轴(chance 50,其他模型的平均值94),以上是至少做其他模型在同一对模型上的平均值的模型数量. 部分是与95%的靴子间隔的局部关联,而Own - - - - - - 其它模型的预测会减去相同的分数。 完结,是平均预测值 减去实际准确度的积分

blocks.en: Table 8 repeats the measures of Sec. 4.1 for other ways of asking.
blocks.zh: 表8重复了第4.1条关于其他询问方式的措施。

blocks.en:
We replaced the two examples of every axis by the next two probe questions that pass the example rule, and by two that the model itself had answered correctly twice, once, or not at all.
The mean prediction is the same in all three cases (84.5%, 84.2%, and 84.2%), so the predictions do not depend on whether the model answers its examples correctly.
With the other example sets, the predictions pick the harder axis more often than with the main examples (58–68% of pairs against 52%), but still far less often than the other models’ average (94%), which at most two models reach.
Their partial correlation is smaller (0.02 to 0.05 against 0.12).
blocks.zh:
我们把每个轴的两个例子替换为后面两个通过例规则的探针问题,用两个模型本身正确回答两次,一次,或根本不正确.
平均预测在所有三种情况下(84.5%,84.2%,84.2%)都是一样的,因此预测并不取决于模型是否正确解答其例子.
在其他例子中,预测比主要例子(58–68 %对比52 %)更经常地选择更硬的轴线,但仍比其他模型的平均数(94 % ) 少得多,后者最多达到两个模型。
其部分关联性较小(0.02至0.05对0.12).

blocks.en: Listing all 13 axes in one prompt, each with its definition and two examples as text, and asking for every axis in one reply gives the same picture, with 62% of pairs and a partial correlation of − 0.06 -0.06 .
blocks.zh: 将所有13个轴一并列出,每个轴都有其定义和两个示例作为文本,在一个回复中询问每个轴给出了同样的图片,62%的对和部分关联为−0.06.

blocks.en:
Some models answer 0% on many axes, mostly the three Mistral models, often with a sentence saying that they cannot process images.
Treating these answers as missing, or leaving out the three Mistral models, changes neither the pair score nor the partial correlation much.
blocks.zh:
一些模型在许多轴上回答0%,大多是三个米斯特拉尔模型,常有句子说它们不能处理图像.
将这些答案视为缺失,或忽略三个米斯特拉尔模型,既不改变对分,也不改变部分相关.

blocks.en: Built instead from random subsets of 5, 8, or 13 other models, from models of other families only, or from the eight weakest or the eight strongest models, the reference still predicts a model’s accuracy per axis better than the model’s own predictions do for at least 20 of the 26 models.
blocks.zh: 取而代之的是从5,8或13个其他模型的随机子集,只从其他家族的模型,或者从8个最弱或8个最强模型中,参考文献仍然预言一个模型的每轴精度优于模型本身对26个模型中至少20个模型的预测.

blocks.en:
We also asked the single-axis prompt about “a typical vision-language model” instead of the model itself.
These answers follow the general difficulty of the axes in 60% of pairs, against 46% when the models are asked about themselves, and even pick the harder axis for the model itself more often (59% against 52%).
The models thus know a little about which kinds of tasks are hard in general but do not apply it to themselves.
blocks.zh:
我们还问单轴提示“典型的视觉语言模型”,而不是模型本身。
这些答案跟随60%的对子中轴的一般难度,当模型被问到自己时为46%,甚至更频繁地为模型本身选择更硬的轴(59%对52%).
因此,这些模型略知哪些任务总的来说是困难的,但并不适用于自己。

blocks.en:
Half of the variance of the model-by-axis part ( Sec. B ) lies along one direction, from perception axes (high-resolution search, OCR, counting, and attribute recognition) to reasoning axes (visual math, chart value reading, and expert-level questions).
Only 14 of the 26 models predict correctly whether they lean further toward perception or toward reasoning than the other models do, about as many as chance would give.
On average, their predictions put the reasoning axes 7 points above the perception axes, whereas their accuracy is 10 points higher on the perception axes.
The correlation between predicted and actual gaps, +0.38, falls to +0.14 without the Mistral models’ answers of 0%.
The models thus do not know even the main direction in which their strengths differ from those of other models.
blocks.zh:
模型逐轴部分(Sec.B)差异的一半位于一个方向上,从感知轴(高分辨率搜索,OCR,计数,和属性识别)到推理轴(视觉数学,图表值读取,以及专家级问题).
26个模型中只有14个能正确预测它们是否比其他模型更倾向于认知或推理,大约是机会所能提供的。
平均来说,他们的预测将推理轴7点置于感知轴之上,而其精确度则在感知轴上高出10点.
预测与实际差距的关联性+0.38下降到+0.14,而米斯特尔模型的答案为0 %.
因此,这些模型甚至不知道其优势与其他模型不同的主要方向。

blocks.en: C.4 Direct choice per pair
blocks.zh: C.4 联合国 每对直接选择

blocks.en:
Figure 12 : Choosing directly between two axes, for all 21 pairs of compared axes.
Each pair is written A > B A>B , with A A the axis of higher mean accuracy over the models, and pairs are ordered by this gap.
For each pair, the bars count the open models that mostly choose the axis they are more accurate on, split their six answers evenly, or mostly choose the other axis, and the right column gives the number of models that are more accurate on A A .
blocks.zh:
图12:两轴之间直接选择,用于所有21对比较轴.
每对都写成A > B > B,A的轴比模型的平均值精确度更高,对数由这个缺口来定购.
对于每对,条会计算大多数选择更精确的轴的开放型号,将6个答案平分,或多选择其他轴,右栏给出A 上更准确的模型数量.

blocks.en:
Each pair of compared axes is asked in both orders and with three wordings, so each model gives six answers per pair ( Fig. 12 ).
In 16 of the 21 pairs, and in all 10 pairs with the largest gaps, more models choose the axis they are worse at.
An even split usually comes from choosing the axis shown first in both orders, and 67% of all answers name the axis shown first.
With the examples as text only, the choices are again at chance (45% [40, 51] of the weighted pairs), and no model reaches the other models’ average.
blocks.zh:
每对比较轴在两种顺序中都有询问,并有三种措辞,因此每个模型每对给出6个答案(图12).
在21对中的16对中,在差距最大的所有10对中,更多的模型选择它们最差的轴.
偶数分裂通常来自选择在两个顺序中先显示的轴,67%的答案将先显示的轴命名.
由于这些例子只是文字,选择机会再次出现(加权对数的45%[40,51]),没有模型达到其他模型的平均值。

blocks.en: D Predictions under image conditions
blocks.zh: D 图像条件下的预测

blocks.en: Figure 13 : Predicted and actual accuracy under image conditions, as in Fig. 5 but averaged over the open models, with the middle half of the models shaded.
blocks.zh: 图13:图像条件下的预测和实际准确度,如图5所示,但平均在开放模型上,模型中间一半有阴影.

blocks.en: Table 9 : Number of open models with each kind of predicted drop under each image condition, the counts that Sec. 4.2 reports for some of the conditions. Worse counts the models whose predicted drop is further from their actual drop than the reference is, Fall those that predict a fall of at least 10 points from the first to the last level, Flat those whose prediction stays within 5 points, and Larger those that predict a larger drop than they show.
blocks.zh: 表9:每种图像条件下预测下降的开放模型数量,第4.2条报告的某些条件的计数。 更糟糕的是,预测下降的模型比参考数字要远, 将预测下降的模型从第一个水平降到最后一个水平至少10点, 将预测停留在5点之内的模型平移, 将预测下降的大于显示的模型平移。

blocks.en:
Figure 14 : How much further each model’s predicted drop is from its actual drop than the reference is, in points, averaged over the levels and axes of each image condition.
Above 0, the other models’ average drop predicts the model’s drop better than the model does.
Dots are open models and the other markers proprietary models.
blocks.zh:
图14:每个模型预测的下降距离其实际下降还有多远,比参考点远得多,以点计,平均为每个图像条件的水平和轴。
0以上,其他模型的平均下降预测模型的下降比模型的下降要好.
点是开放的模型,其他标记的专有模型.

blocks.en:
For lower resolution, each side of the image is scaled to 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, and 1/32 of its original length, and the image is not scaled back up.
Blur is Gaussian with a standard deviation of 0.4, 0.8, 1.6, 3.2, and 6.4% of the shorter side, JPEG compression uses qualities 20, 10, 6, 3, and 1, occlusion covers 20, 35, 65, 80, and 95% of the image with grey rectangles, and noise is Gaussian with a standard deviation of 8, 15, 25, 40, and 60% of the intensity range.
We chose these five levels in a pilot with three models so that accuracy falls in roughly even steps from the original toward chance.
For object counts, the questions come from CountQA 1 1 1 J. S. Tamarapalli, R. Grover, N. Pande, and S. Yerramilli. CountQA: How Well Do MLLMs Count in the Wild? arXiv:2508.06585, 2025. , real photos grouped by their true count into 1–3, 4–6, 7–10, 11–15, 16–20, and 21–50 objects.
Each level is scored on 100 evaluation questions per axis, the same questions at every level of a condition.
An image below the smallest size a model accepts counts as answered wrong.
blocks.zh:
对于更低的分辨率,图像的每个侧面缩放为1,1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16,以及原长度的1/32,图像不缩放回放.
Blur是高斯人,标准偏差为0.4,0.8,1.6,3.2和6.4%的短侧,JPEG压缩采用品质20,10,6,3和1,封装覆盖20,35,65,80,95%的图像带有灰色矩形,噪音是高斯人,标准偏差为8,15,25,40,强度范围60%.
我们选择了这5个级别,在试运行时有3个模型 这样精确度就会从最初的几步下降到机会的几步。
对于物体计数,问题来自QA伯爵11 1 J. S. Tamarapalli, R. Grover, N. Pande, S. Yerramilli. QA伯爵: MLLMs 如何在野外计数? arXiv:2508.06585, 2025. 真实照片按真实的计数分组为 1–3, 4–6, 7–10, 11–15, 16–20, 21–50个对象.
每个关卡每轴100个评价问题得分,一个条件的每个关卡都有同样的问题.
在最小大小以下的图像中,一个模型接受被回答错误的计数。

blocks.en:
The prompt shows three example questions of the axis with their images at the level and asks for the accuracy on 100 such questions ( Sec. 4.2 ).
We ask with three sets of three example questions, all probe questions, and with three wordings, and average the nine answers.
The drop error is the mean absolute difference between the predicted and the actual drop from the first level, over the five levels after it.
The reference uses the other open models’ mean actual drop in place of the predicted drop.
blocks.zh:
该提示用其图像显示三个轴线问题,并询问100个此类问题的准确性(第4.2节)。
我们用三组例问,三组例问,都是探查问题,还有三句,平均九个答案.
跌落误差是预测的与从第一级实际跌落之间的平均绝对差数,超过之后的5级.
参考使用其他开放模型的平均实际下降数,以取代预测的下降数。

blocks.en:
Figure 13 shows the curves averaged over the open models, Tab. 9 counts the models condition by condition, and Fig. 14 shows every model.
In every condition, the reference predicts the drop of nearly every model better than the model does, and over the four degradations together it does so for all 25 models.
Under JPEG compression, both the predicted and the actual drops are small, so the difference is smallest there.
Among the proprietary models, GPT-6.1 Terra and Claude Sonnet 5.5 come closest to the reference.
On lower resolution they match it, with predicted drops 0.5 and 1.1 points closer to the actual drops than the reference is, but the reference fits them poorly, since their accuracy starts about 20 points higher than that of the open models and falls to the same level, so it misses their drops by 13.5 and 12.1 points against 6.4 for the median open model.
On the four degradations they stay 2 and 3 points behind it.
On counting, Claude Sonnet 5.5 predicts its drop much better than the reference and Gemini 3.8 Flash about as well, because their accuracy falls far less than that of the open models as objects become more numerous.
blocks.zh:
图13显示开放模型上的曲线平均值 Tab. 9按条件计算模型条件,图14显示每个模型.
在每个条件中,参考预测几乎每个模型的下降比模型的下降要好,在这四个降解过程中,它一起对所有25个模型都是如此.
在JPEG压缩下,预测和实际的下降都很小,所以那里的差异最小.
在专有模型中,GPT-6.1 Terra和Claude Sonnet 5.5最接近参考.
在较低的分辨率上,它们与它相匹配,预测的下降0.5和1.1点比参考物更接近实际的下降,但参考物却不合适,因为它们的精确度比开放式模型的精确度高约20点,并下降到相同的水平,因此它错过了它们的下降13.5和12.1点,而中位开放式模型则差6.4点.
在四个退化地上,它们停留在后面2和3点。
根据计算,克洛德·索内特5.5预测其下降比参考和双子座3.8闪电还好得多,因为随着物体数量增加,其准确度远低于开放模型。

blocks.en: E Records in context
blocks.zh: 英 相关记录

blocks.en:
Figure 15 : The prompt with a record of two questions, for counting, with the record of Qwen3-VL-8B.
Without correctness, the second sentence of the record reads “It shows your answers but not whether they were right.” and the Result lines are left out.
The count line replaces the record by “Here is a summary of questions of this kind that you answered earlier.” followed by “Counting objects: 1 of 2 correct (50%)”.
blocks.zh:
图15:有两个问题记录的提示,用于计数,与Qune3-VL-8B的记录.
没有正确性,记录的第二句是: “它显示的是你们的答案,但不是答案是否正确。”
计数行将记录替换为“这是你先前回答的这类问题的摘要”。

blocks.en: Table 10 : Mean error of predicted accuracy over the open models, in points, by the number of questions per axis in the record. The record shows the answers with or without whether they were correct, or only a line with the count of correct answers. The last two columns are not asked: the accuracy in the record used as the prediction, and the best estimate from the record, which moves the accuracy in the record toward the other models’ average accuracy, the more so the shorter the record.
blocks.zh: 表10:按点数计算,按记录中每轴问题数计算,开放模型的预测准确度平均误差。 记录显示答案是否正确,或仅与正确答案的数一致。 最后两栏没有被问及:用作预测的记录的准确性,以及记录中的最佳估计,这把记录中的准确性推向其他模型的平均准确性,记录越短。

blocks.en:
Figure 16 : Figure 6 a for all 26 open models: error of predicted accuracy with 15 questions per axis in the record.
Models are ordered by how close the record with correctness brings them to the accuracy in the record, and short marks show the other models’ average accuracy used as the prediction.
blocks.zh:
图16:所有26个开放模型的图6 a:预测准确性错误,记录中每轴15个问题.
模型的顺序是记录的正确性使其接近记录中的准确性,短的标记显示其他模型用作预测的平均准确性。

blocks.en:
The record of a model on an axis consists of probe questions that the model answered earlier.
For each length we draw five different records, ask each with the three wordings, and average the fifteen answers.
Each entry gives the question, the model’s answer, and whether it was correct ( Fig. 15 ).
We also show the same entries without correctness, a single line with the count of correct answers, another model’s entries presented as the model’s own, and, for two questions per axis, the entries with their images.
blocks.zh:
在一个轴上的模型记录包括了该模型早些时候回答的探测问题.
每个长度,我们分别绘制5个不同的记录,分别问三个措辞,平均15个答案。
每个条目给出问题,模型的答案,以及是否正确(图15).
我们还显示同样的条目,没有正确性, 与正确答案的计数一致的单行, 另一个模型的条目作为模型自己的, 对于每个轴的两个问题, 条目的图像。

blocks.en:
Table 10 gives the error by record length, and Fig. 16 gives every model.
Replacing the entries by the count of correct answers leaves the error about the same (12 against 12 points with 15 questions), so counting the correct answers is not what limits the models.
With the count given, 89% of the answers that differ from the shown accuracy lie above it, so part of the error is overestimation that remains even when the model is told how often it was right.
When another model’s record is presented as the model’s own, the prediction moves 5.4 points [4.6, 6.3] for every 10 points of difference between the two records, and it moves toward the other record for all 26 models, so the models follow the evidence they are shown, whoever it comes from.
With two questions per axis, adding the images to the entries changes the error by less than a point (21.3 against 20.6 points).
The best estimate from the same record would have an error of 5.8 points with 15 questions, about half that of the models.
Showing the records of all 13 axes mixed together, without axis names, helps more than the record of the asked axis when the records are short (14.9 against 20.6 points with two questions per axis), since the other axes also show how often the model is right overall, and slightly less with 15 questions (13.6 against 12.3).
blocks.zh:
表10按记录长度给出了错误,图16给出了每个模型.
用正确答案的计数来替换条目,使得错误大致相同(12对12点,15个问题),所以计算正确答案并不是限制模型的原因.
在给出的计数中,89%与所显示的准确性不同的答案位于其上方,因此部分误差是高估的,即使该模型被告知它有多经常是正确的,也依然保留下来.
当另一个模型的记录被呈现为模型自己的记录时,预测会将两个记录之间每10个差点的5.4点[4.6,6.3]移动到另一个记录上,然后所有26个模型都移动到另一个记录上,所以模型都遵循它们所显示的证据,无论它来自谁.
每轴有两个问题,将图像添加到条目中,使误差变化不到一个点(21.3对20.6点).
同一记录中的最佳估计是5.8分的错误,有15个问题,大约是模型的一半。
显示所有13轴的混合记录,没有轴名,在记录短(14.9对20.6点,每轴有两个问题)时,比被问轴的记录更有帮助,因为其他的轴也显示模型整体的正确度有多高,15个问题(13.6对12.3)则略低.

blocks.en: F Training on past outcomes
blocks.zh: F 级 关于以往成果的培训
