Each fold also leaves out one degradation of the image conditions (fold 1 blur; fold 2 JPEG compression; fold 3 occlusion; fold 4 noise), and the object counts go with counting.
blocks.zh: 表11:Sec. 5.2的31种任务按提示中的名称排列,按轴线和将轴线伸出的折叠排列. 每个折叠还留下一个图像条件的降解(倍数 1 模糊;折叠 2 JPEG 压缩;折叠 3 隐蔽;折叠 4 噪声),对象计数随计数.

blocks.en: Table 12 : Candidates for the other model of Sec. 5.2 : the four open models within 10 points of the trained model’s accuracy whose strengths and weaknesses relative to the other models are least like its own, measured by the partial correlation of the two models’ accuracies on kinds of tasks and on image conditions. * marks the model chosen, the least alike among those answered with the same inference settings; † marks models left out because their outputs differ between the two inference engines.
blocks.zh: 表12: Sec. 5.2的另一个模型的候选者:在经过训练的模型精度的10点之内的4个开放模型,其优缺点与其他模型的优缺点最不相似,以两个模型在任务种类和图像条件上的局部相关性来衡量. * 标记所选择的模型,在以相同的推论设置被回答的模型中最小的相同; 标记模型因两个推论引擎的输出不同而被忽略.

blocks.en: Table 13 : Table 2 with the last row of each model trained on the accuracy of a second other model, Qwen3.5-9B or Gemma-4-31B. The other rows and the columns are those of Tab. 2 .
blocks.zh: 表13:每个型号最后一行的表2对另一个型号(Quen3.5-9B或Gemma-4-31B)的精度进行了培训. 其他的行和列是塔布的. 2 (英语).

blocks.en: Table 14 : Differences in the partial correlation between the model trained on its own accuracy and the model named in each column, which is the other model of Tab. 2 , the second other model of Tab. 13 , or the untrained model, with 95% bootstrap intervals.
blocks.zh: 表14:按自身准确性培训的模型与每列中命名的模型在部分相关性上的差异,这是Tab的另一个模型. 2,塔布13的第二个其他型号,或未经过训练的型号,95%的靴子间隔.

blocks.en:
The 31 kinds of tasks split the axes by source benchmark or benchmark subset ( Tab. 11 ).
Each kind has its own name and definition, written from its questions, so that the kinds of one axis differ in more than their examples.
The 109 image conditions are the six resolutions of the four axes of Sec. 4.2 , the five levels of each degradation on the same axes, and five of the six ranges of object counts, since the range of 1–3 objects has no questions left for training.
blocks.zh:
31种任务按源基准或基准子集划分轴(Tab. 11).
每一种都有它自己的名称和定义,用它的问题书写,这样一轴的种类就比它们的例子不同.
109图像条件为Sec.4.2的四轴的六个分辨率,同一轴上每个降解的五个级别,以及6个范围的物体计数中的5个,因为1-3个物体的范围没有问题留待训练.

blocks.en:
Each fold leaves out the axes of Tab. 11 with all their kinds and conditions, and one degradation, so that between 21 and 25 kinds of tasks remain for training.
A kind or condition is evaluated with the model of the first fold that leaves it out.
blocks.zh:
每一叠都留下了Tab 11的轴,有各种类型和条件,并有一次退化,因此仍有21至25种任务需要训练.
一种或条件用第一个折叠的模型来评价,而这个模型不包含它.

blocks.en:
The training set of a fold, about 1,600 prompts, has four equal parts.
Two ask for the accuracy on a kind of task or an image condition with the prompts of Secs. 4.1 and 4.2 , and two ask with direct-choice prompts which of two kinds or two conditions the model does better on.
The answer is the model’s accuracy on the probe questions of the kind or the training questions of the condition, and for a pair the one with the higher accuracy, using only pairs that differ by at least 10 points.
The example questions of the training prompts never appear in the evaluation prompts.
blocks.zh:
一个折叠的训练集,大约1600个导线,有四个相等的部分.
两位要求精确地处理某种任务或图像条件,并附上Secs 4.1和4.2的提示;两位要求直接选择提示,其中两种或两种条件的模型更适合。
答案是模型对探测器问题的准确性或条件的训练问题,对于一对精度较高的一对,只使用至少10分不同的对.
培训提示的例子问题从未出现在评价提示中。

blocks.en:
We train LoRA adapters of rank 16, with scale 32 and dropout 0.05, on all attention and MLP projections of the language model, with AdamW at a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a linear warm-up over the first 5% of the steps and a linear decay to zero, gradients accumulated over 8 prompts, and two epochs.
The loss covers only the answer, and the images keep their original size.
The trained adapters are evaluated in vLLM, like the untrained versions of these models ( Sec. B ).
We use supervised fine-tuning because the model’s past accuracy on each kind is a known target.
Other training methods might do better, since evolution strategies teach language models to judge whether they know the answer to a single question better than supervised fine-tuning does [ 45 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们训练16级的LORA适配器,32级和0.05级,对语言模型进行所有注意和MLP预测,亚当W的学习速度为10 - 4 10 - 4 Q 4 },在前5%的步数上线性变暖,线性衰变为零,梯度积聚在8个梯度,以及两个纪元。
损失只涵盖答案,图像保持原有大小.
训练有素的适配器在vLLM中被评价,就像这些模型未经训练的版本(Sec.B.).
我们使用有监督的微调,因为每一种模型的过去准确性都是已知的目标。
其他培训方法可能更好,因为演化战略教语言模型判断他们是否比监督的微调更了解一个问题的答案[45]。

blocks.en:
The Pairs score of Tab. 2 uses every pair of kinds of tasks left out by the same fold, so that the model was trained on neither kind, which gives 15, 21, 28, and 45 pairs in the four folds.
For image conditions it uses 200 sampled pairs per fold.
Each pair is asked in both orders with the three wordings.
blocks.zh:
塔布的对等分数. 2使用同一折叠留下的每对任务,使模型被训练为两种,这给15,21,28和45对四折叠.
对于图像条件,它每叠使用200对样本。
每种配对在两种顺序中都以三种措辞提出。

blocks.en:
Besides the rule of Sec. 5.2 , the other model must be one whose answers come out the same through the inference engine used for training, which leaves out the InternVL and Mistral models ( Tab. 12 ).
We also trained each model on the accuracy of a second other model, Qwen3.5-9B or Gemma-4-31B ( Tab. 13 ), with the same conclusions.
blocks.zh:
除了Sec. 5.2的规则外,另一个型号必须是一个通过训练用的推论引擎得出相同答案的型号,它排除了InternVL和Mistral型号(Tab. 12).
我们还对每个模型进行了关于另一个模型(Quen3.5-9B或Gemma-4-31B(Tab. 13))准确性的培训,结论相同.

blocks.en:
Table 14 gives the differences in the partial correlation with 95% bootstrap intervals that resample the axes for kinds of tasks and the degradation curves for image conditions, since the kinds of one axis and the levels of one curve are not independent.
For no model and neither type does training on its own accuracy give a reliably larger partial correlation than training on another model’s, and the rise of GLM-4.6V-Flash with training is reliable only on image conditions.
Scoring the same predictions on the 11 axes of Sec. 4.1 leads to the same conclusions, with wider intervals over the fewer units.
blocks.zh:
表14给出了部分关联性的差异,与95%的靴子间隔,这些间隔对各种任务的轴进行重新取样,对图像条件进行降解曲线,因为一个轴的种类和一个曲线的级别并不独立.
因为没有一种模型,也没有一种类型的培训本身的准确性提供了可靠更大的局部关联性,而GLM-4.6V-Flash的上升加上培训只在图像条件下才是可靠的。
在Sec 4.1的11轴上对相同的预测进行分解,得出相同的结论,间隔比较少的单位更长.

blocks.en: G Decisions
blocks.zh: G 决定

blocks.en: Table 15 : Values of Fig. 7 and of the threshold decision, before and after training. Each cell gives Qwen3.5-9B / Gemma-4-31B / GLM-4.6V-Flash. The other model is the one of Sec. 5.2 , and for the image budget the model whose drops are least like those of the trained model. Handing off uses the 11 axes and the questions of Sec. 4.1 , and the threshold uses the kinds of Tab. 2 , with the threshold at the model’s median accuracy over the kinds or averaged over fixed thresholds from 0.5 to 0.9. The image budget is decided by models trained on drops.
blocks.zh: 表15:图7和门槛决定值,培训前后。 每个细胞给出Quen3.5-9B / Gemma-4-31B / GLM-4.6V-Flash. 另一种型号是第5.2sec.的型号,对于图像预算来说,其下降率最不像训练有素的型号的型号. 交接使用11轴和Sec 4.1的问题,门槛使用Tab的种类. 2,在模型的中位精度上标出该型号的阈值,或者在固定阈值上标出0.5至0.9的平均值. 图像预算由受过滴水训练的模型决定.

blocks.en:
Handing off is scored as in Sec. 5.3 , on 50 evaluation questions from each of the 11 scored axes.
Before training, the scores of the 26 open models range from − 0.81 -0.81 to 0.94 0.94 , with a median of 0.00, and only one model reaches the other models’ average.
The three trained models are scored on the same questions before and after training ( Tab. 15 ).
blocks.zh:
交出得分与第5.3节一样,涉及来自11个得分轴的50个评价问题。
在训练前,26个开放型号的分数从−0.81-0.81到0.94 0.94,中位数为0.00,只有一个型号达到其他型号的平均值.
三个训练有素的模型在训练前和训练后在同样的问题上打分(Tab.15)。

blocks.en:
A model answers the questions of a kind if its predicted accuracy on the kind reaches a threshold and hands them off otherwise.
An answered kind gains its accuracy minus the threshold, a handed-off kind gains nothing, and the total is scaled so that answering every kind gives 0 and deciding with the actual accuracy gives 1. Table 15 gives the results.
With the threshold at the model’s median accuracy over the kinds, training on its own accuracy raises the score on kinds of tasks for all three models, most for GLM-4.6V-Flash (from 0.20 to 0.78, against 0.02 when trained on another model’s), while training on another model’s accuracy raises it more for Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma-4-31B.
On image conditions, training on its own accuracy raises the score only for Qwen3.5-9B.
Averaged over fixed thresholds from 0.5 to 0.9, training raises it on image conditions instead, as much with another model’s accuracy as with its own, and changes it little on kinds of tasks.
The other models’ average accuracy scores at least as high in all but one of the twelve comparisons, and because the result depends on the threshold, the main text reports the two decisions that do not need one.
blocks.zh:
如果一种模型预测的准确性达到一个临界值,而以其他方式将其交付出去,则模型可以回答这类问题。
一个被回答的种类会提高它的准确度减去阈值,一个交接的种类不会增加任何收益,而且总数会按比例计算,这样,每个种类的回答都会给出0,用实际的准确度来决定。 1. 表15列出结果。
随着模型的中位精度高于各类,关于精度的培训提高了所有三种模型,主要是GLM-4.6V-Flash(在接受另一模型的培训时从0.20到0.78,对0.02)的任务种类的分数,而关于另一模型精度的培训则提高了Quen3.5-9B和Gemma-4-31B的分数。
在图像条件方面,训练本身的精度只能提高Qwen3.5-9B的分数.
平均超过固定阈值从0.5到0.9, 训练则在图像条件上提高它, 其精确度与它自己的相同,
其他模型的平均准确度在除12个比较中的一个之外的所有比较中至少都得到同样高的分数,并且由于结果取决于阈值,所以正文报告了两个不需要一个的决定.

blocks.en:
An image costs its number of pixels under lower resolution and its file size under JPEG compression, and the tolerated losses go from 0 to 20 points in steps of 1 point.
The distance from the best choice is averaged over the eight curves and the tolerated losses.
With the drops implied by their predictions in Sec. 4.2 , 24 of the 25 open models choose worse than they would with the other models’ average drops, and they lose 7.8 points of accuracy against the best choice on average, against 1.0 point with the other models’ drops.
blocks.zh:
图像在下分辨率下花费其像素数量,在JPEG压缩下花费其文件大小,容忍的损失在1点的步数中从0到20点.
与最佳选择的距离平均在8个曲线和容忍的损失上.
25个开放模型中有24个选择了比其他模型的平均下降更糟糕的,它们平均比最佳选择损失了7.8分,而其他模型的下降则损失了1.0分。

blocks.en:
For training on drops, the prompt shows an image at its original quality and the same image at one level of a degradation, with the question asked about it, and asks how many points lower the model’s accuracy would be with such images.
The kinds are the five levels of resolution, blur, JPEG compression, occlusion, and noise on the four axes, 100 in all, with four folds by axis as in Sec. F .
The answer is the model’s own drop on the training questions of the kind, from the original to the level, and the training settings are those of Sec. F .
The other model is chosen by the rule of Sec. 5.2 with the likeness of the two models’ drops: Gemma-4-26B-A4B for Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-VL-8B for Gemma-4-31B, and Qwen3.5-4B for GLM-4.6V-Flash.
Training on its own drops brings the choices closer to the best than training on the other model’s drops for Qwen3.5-9B and GLM-4.6V-Flash and less close for Gemma-4-31B ( Tab. 15 ), with intervals that include zero for all three.
Training on accuracy ( Sec. 5.2 ) does not help with this decision, since the models trained that way choose 1.7 levels from the best on average, the same as before training, against 1.0 after training on drops.
blocks.zh:
对于滴水培训,提示显示一个图像的原始质量,一个退化的层次显示同一图像,并询问这个问题,并询问这种模型的准确度会降低多少点。
类型是分辨率的五级,模糊,JPEG压缩,隐蔽,以及四轴上的噪音,共100个,像Sec.F.一样,有四个折叠轴.
答案是模型自己在从原始到层次的训练问题上投放,训练环境是F.Sec.F.。
另一种模型由Sec. 5.2规则选择,与两种模型的下降相似: Gemma-4-26B-A4B代表Quen3.5-9B,Quen3-VL-8B代表Gemma-4-31B,Quen3.5-4B代表GLM-4.6V-Flash.
自行投篮的训练使得选手更接近于其他型号投篮的训练(Quen3.5-9B和GLM-4.6V-Flash),而Gemma-4-31B(Tab. 15)的选手更接近于选手,其间隔包括所有三个选手的0.
准确性培训(第5.2节)无助于作出这一决定,因为通过这种方式培训的模型从平均最佳水平中选择1.7级,与培训前相同,在培训结束后选择1.0级。

blocks.en: H Probing the hidden states
blocks.zh: 页:1 探测隐藏状态

blocks.en: Table 16 : Linear probes on hidden states before solving. Each row predicts one model’s accuracy on held-out kinds from the hidden states of each of the three models (its own in bold) and gives the partial correlation of Sec. 4.1 with a 95% bootstrap interval; the last column is the model’s own stated prediction before training.
blocks.zh: 表16:解前隐藏状态的线性探测器. 每行都从三种模型的隐藏状态(它自己用粗体表示)中预测出一种模型在被搁置类型上的准确性,并给出了Sec. 4.1的部分相关性,其间隔为95%;最后一栏是模型自己在训练前的预测。

blocks.en:
A model might represent its weaknesses without stating them.
For each of the three models of Sec. 5.2 , we take the hidden state where its answer would begin, at the end of the prompt that asks for its accuracy on a kind ( Secs. 4.1 and 4.2 ).
We take it at a quarter, half, three quarters, and the full depth of the language model and average it over the prompts of the kind.
A ridge regression maps these averages to the model’s accuracy on the kinds of the training folds, with the depth and the penalty chosen by cross-validation within those folds, and predicts the kinds left out ( Tab. 16 ).
As the second standard, we fit the same probe to the hidden states of the other two models.
On the 31 kinds of tasks, the probes find no part particular to the model, with partial correlations of − - 0.38 for Qwen3.5-9B, − - 0.24 for Gemma-4-31B, and + 0.22 +0.22 for GLM-4.6V-Flash, none of whose intervals lies above zero.
On image conditions, only the probe for GLM-4.6V-Flash shows this part ( + 0.44 +0.44 ), but probes on the hidden states of the other two models show it nearly as well ( + 0.35 +0.35 and + 0.33 +0.33 ).
The probe on its own hidden states exceeds them by only +0.09 [ − - 0.11, +0.28], so this information is not particular to its own hidden states.
Before a model solves any question, a linear probe thus finds no more about its weaknesses in its own hidden states than in those of other models.
With about 23 kinds of tasks or 70 image conditions per fold, the probes have little data, so these results show only that we find no such information, not that it is absent.
blocks.zh:
一个模型可能代表了它的弱点,而不加以说明。
对于Sec. 5.2 的三种模型中的每一一种,我们采取隐藏状态,其答案将从该状态开始,在以某种方式要求其准确性的提示(Secs. 4.1和4.2.)的结尾.
我们把它在四分之一,一半,四分之三, 和语言模型的全部深度, 并平均在这样的提示。
一个山脊回归图将这些平均值映射到模型对训练折叠种类的精确度,其中深度和罚则通过这些折叠内部的交叉验证来选择,并预测所剩种类(图16)。
作为第二个标准,我们把同样的探测器与另外两个模型的隐藏状态相匹配.
在31种任务上,探测器发现该型号没有部分特殊性,部分关联度为-−0.38对Quen3.5-9B,−−0.24对Gemma-4-31B,+0.22+0.22对GLM-4.6V-Flash,其间隔均高于零.
在图像条件下,只有GLM-4.6V-Flash的探测器显示这部分(+0.44+0.44),但在另外两种模型的隐藏状态上的探测器也显示它几乎同样(+0.35+0.35和+0.33+0.33).
探测器在自己的隐藏状态上只超过它们+0.09[−−−0.11,+0.28],因此这种信息对于它自己的隐藏状态来说并不特别.
在模型解决任何问题之前,线性探测器在自己的隐藏状态中发现的弱点并不比其他模型的弱点多。
由于每叠有大约23种任务或70个图像条件,探测器几乎没有数据,因此这些结果只显示我们没有找到这样的信息,而不是它不存在.

blocks.en: I Answer probability
blocks.zh: I 回答概率

blocks.en: Table 17 : The answer probability by the number of questions per axis, for the 26 open models. Part. is the partial correlation of Sec. 4.1 with a 95% bootstrap interval over models, followed by the number of models above 0 and above their stated predictions. Hand-off is the score of Sec. 5.3 when the axes are ordered by the answer probability.
blocks.zh: 表17:按每轴题数表示的26个开放型号的答案概率. 部分是Sec.4.1的部分相关性,比模型的靴子间隔为95%,然后是模型数量高于0和高于其陈述的预测. 交接(Hand-off)是按答概率排列轴时,第5.3sec.

blocks.en:
The answers are those of the evaluation in Sec. 3 , and we take the probability that the model assigns to the tokens of its own reply.
For five questions per axis, we draw the questions 200 times and average the partial correlation over the draws. Table 17 gives the result for 5, 10, and 20 questions per axis and for all questions.
The signal grows with the number of questions but is already clear with five.
The drawn questions are also among those that define the accuracy, but this overlap does not produce the signal.
Leaving the five drawn questions out of the accuracy and the reference changes the partial correlation by less than 0.01, and taking the answer probability from a random half of the questions and the accuracy and reference from the other half gives +0.35 [+0.25, +0.45], against +0.38 when both come from the same half.
blocks.zh:
答案是Sec. 3中的评价,我们假设模型会给它自己答复的符号分配。
对于每个轴线的五个问题,我们绘制问题200倍,并平均抽取部分相关. 表17列出每轴5、10和20个问题以及所有问题的结果。
信号随着问题数的增加而增加,但已经清晰了五个问题.
所引的问题也属于定义准确性的问题,但这种重叠并不产生信号.
将五个抽出的问题从准确度中抽出,参考值将部分关联性改变不到0.01,从随机的半个问题中抽取答案概率,再从另一半中抽取准确度和参考值给+0.35 [+0.25,+0.45],而两者来自同一半个问题时为+0.38.

blocks.en:
Replies differ in length between axes, so we check that the signal does not come from their length.
Removing each model’s mean log reply length together with the reference changes the partial correlation from + 0.36 +0.36 to + 0.38 +0.38 [ + 0.24 +0.24 , + 0.51 +0.51 ].
The 6 models whose median reply has at most three tokens, which give little room for length to matter, average + 0.50 +0.50 .
blocks.zh:
不同轴之间的响应长度不同,所以我们检查信号不是来自它们的长度.
删除每个模型的平均日志答复长度以及参考文献,将部分关联性从+0.36+0.36改为+0.38+0.38[+0.24+0.24,+0.51+0.51]]。
其中位数回复的6种型号最多有3个符号,其长度没有太大的分量,平均+0.50+0.50.

blocks.en:
For lower resolution, we take the answer probability from 20 questions per axis and level, for the 16 models whose number of image tokens falls with the resolution, since only for them does a smaller image save cost.
The other models resize every image to the same number of tokens.
blocks.zh:
对于更低的分辨率,我们从每轴和级别20个问题中得出答案概率,对于16个模型,其图像符号数量与分辨率一致,因为只有它们才有较小的图像节省成本。
其他模型将每个图像的大小调整为相同数量的符号.

blocks.en:
We also make the decisions of Sec. 5.3 with the answer probability.
Ordering the axes by it for handing off scores 0.11 with five questions per axis and 0.22 with all questions, against 0.84 for the other models’ average accuracy ( Tab. 17 ).
Adding it to the other models’ average drops changes the image budget by only + 0.01 +0.01 levels.
The answer probability thus carries information particular to the model, but it is not yet strong enough to make these decisions better than the other models’ results do.
blocks.zh:
我们还以答案概率作出第5.3条的决定。
由它订购轴以传递0.11分,每轴5个问题,0.22分和所有问题,而其他模型的平均准确性为0.84(Tab.17)。
加上其他模型的平均下降,图像预算只改变+0.01+0.01级.
因此,答案概率包含着模型特有的信息,但尚不足以使这些决定比其他模型的结果更好。

blocks.en:
As a first attempt, we trained Qwen3.5-9B to state its accuracy on a kind after seeing five of its earlier answers on the kind, without being told whether they were right, with the folds of Sec. F .
On image conditions, its predictions then follow its particular drops more than after training on other models’ accuracy (partial correlation + 0.16 +0.16 [+0.05, +0.29] higher), but Qwen2.5-VL-7B trained to read the same answers does about as well ( + 0.04 +0.04 [ − - 0.04, +0.15]), and on kinds of tasks neither shows this signal.
For this one model, what the trained model puts into words can thus be read from its answers by another model as well, and whether a model can report more about itself than others can read from its answers remains open.
blocks.zh:
作为第一次尝试,我们训练了Quen3.5-9B,在看到它早先的五个答案后,在某种类型上说明它的准确性,而没有被告知它们是否正确,有Sec.F.的折叠.
在图像条件方面,它的预测比其他模型的精确度(部分关联性+0.16+0.16[+0.05,+0.29]更高)培训后更能跟踪其特定的下降情况,但Quen2.5-VL-7B培训后读取同样答案的情况也是如此(+0.04+0.04[−-0.04,+0.15]),在各类任务上也没有显示这一信号.
对于这个模型,训练有素的模型所写成的文字也可以用另一个模型从答案中读出来,一个模型能否比其他模型从答案中读到更多的自我报告,现在仍然没有定论。

blocks.en: J Reasoning turned on

blocks.en: Table 18 : Two models with reasoning turned off and on, and the median of the open models with reasoning off. blocks.en:
All results in the main text are with reasoning turned off.
We reran every stage, including the evaluation of accuracy, for Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-31B with reasoning turned on, in vLLM with greedy decoding and at most 16,384 new tokens ( Tab. 18 ).
Reasoning makes the stated numbers less overconfident and closer to the actual accuracy under image conditions, much more for Qwen3.8-27B than for Gemma-4-31B.
Reasoning does not teach the models which axis is harder for them.
Gemma-4-31B picks the harder axis in 78% of pairs, below the other models’ average (89%).
Qwen3.8-27B moves from reversing the order of the axes (21%) only to about chance (56%), and still rates high-resolution search lowest although its accuracy there is above its average.
For Qwen3.8-27B the other models’ average does no better (51%), because reasoning changes its own accuracy, most on visual math (from 78% to 90%).
Asked directly which of two axes they would do better on, Qwen3.8-27B stays below chance (41%) and Gemma-4-31B at chance (51%).
The models thus still do not know which kinds of tasks are hard for them in particular when reasoning is on, although their stated numbers become less overconfident.
With only two models and no intervals, these results may not hold for other models.
blocks.zh:
主文中的所有结果都与推理关闭.
在VLLM中,我们用贪婪的解码和最多16,384个新符号(Tab. 18)重排每个阶段,包括精确度评价。
理性使得所声明的数字不那么自信,更接近图像条件下的实际准确性,对Qune3.8-27B来说比Gemma-4-31B要多得多.
理性并不会教他们哪个轴线更难。
Gemma-4-31 (英语). 乙级 在78%的对子中选择更硬的轴线,低于其他模型的平均值(89%)。
文选3.8-27 B从轴(21%)的顺序倒转到机会(56%),高分辨率搜索率仍然最低,尽管其准确度高于平均水平。
用于 Quen3.8-27B 其他模型的平均值并没有改善(51%),因为推理会改变其自身的准确性,主要是在视觉数学上(从78%到90%).
Qwen3.8-27B在机会(41%)和Gemma-4-31B(51%)之下。
因此,这些模型仍然不知道哪些任务对他们来说是困难的,特别是在进行推理时,尽管它们所说的数字变得不那么自信。
由于只有两个模型而且没有间隔,这些结果可能无法维持其他模型。
